#!/usr/bin/env bash
# ATDD-MIN-1 verification wrapper. Runs the capsule's focused verification and
# records wall-clock command runtime to a ledger outside the repository, so
# active agent time can be separated from test-command runtime symmetrically
# across both arms.
set -uo pipefail

LEDGER="${ATDD_VERIFY_LEDGER:-/dev/null}"
export DB_CONNECTION=mysql
export DB_HOST=127.0.0.1
export DB_PORT=3306
export DB_USERNAME=root
export DB_DATABASE="${ATDD_TEST_DB:-jakomeet_testing}"
unset DB_PASSWORD

start=$(python3 -c 'import time;print(time.time())')
vendor/bin/phpunit --configuration=.atdd-phpunit.xml "$@"
status=$?
end=$(python3 -c 'import time;print(time.time())')

python3 - "$LEDGER" "$start" "$end" "$status" "$*" <<'PY'
import json, sys
ledger, start, end, status, argv = sys.argv[1], float(sys.argv[2]), float(sys.argv[3]), int(sys.argv[4]), sys.argv[5]
if ledger != "/dev/null":
    with open(ledger, "a") as fh:
        fh.write(json.dumps({"start": start, "end": end, "seconds": round(end - start, 3), "status": status, "args": argv}) + "\n")
PY

exit $status

# ATDD-MIN-1 verification wrapper. Runs the capsule's focused verification and
# records wall-clock command runtime to a ledger outside the repository, so
# active agent time can be separated from test-command runtime symmetrically
# across both arms.
set -uo pipefail

LEDGER="${ATDD_VERIFY_LEDGER:-/dev/null}"
export DB_CONNECTION=mysql
export DB_HOST=127.0.0.1
export DB_PORT=3306
export DB_USERNAME=root
export DB_DATABASE="${ATDD_TEST_DB:-jakomeet_testing}"
unset DB_PASSWORD

start=$(python3 -c 'import time;print(time.time())')
vendor/bin/phpunit --configuration=.atdd-phpunit.xml "$@"
status=$?
end=$(python3 -c 'import time;print(time.time())')

python3 - "$LEDGER" "$start" "$end" "$status" "$*" <<'PY'
import json, sys
ledger, start, end, status, argv = sys.argv[1], float(sys.argv[2]), float(sys.argv[3]), int(sys.argv[4]), sys.argv[5]
if ledger != "/dev/null":
    with open(ledger, "a") as fh:
        fh.write(json.dumps({"start": start, "end": end, "seconds": round(end - start, 3), "status": status, "args": argv}) + "\n")
PY

exit $status

<?php

declare(strict_types=1);

namespace App\Modules\Events\Enums;

/**
 * Story 2-1 — Canonical event state machine (Phase 1, 8 states, 20 legal edges).
 *
 * Single source of truth: docs/specs/event-states.md (PF-1 Reading A,
 * reconciled 2026-04-25).
 *
 * - DB column: VARCHAR — values match the lowercase string values below.
 * - SUSPENDED is reachable from any non-SUSPENDED state via EventService::suspend().
 * - Reactivation from SUSPENDED uses the audit ledger (see Story 2-6 sketch).
 */
enum EventState: string
{
    case DRAFT = 'draft';
    case PUBLISHED = 'published';
    case PREPARING = 'preparing';
    case READY = 'ready';
    case LIVE = 'live';
    case ENDED = 'ended';
    case FAILED = 'failed';
    case SUSPENDED = 'suspended';

    /**
     * Canonical legal-transition table. Mirrors docs/specs/event-states.md.
     *
     * @return list<self>
     */
    public function transitionsTo(): array
    {
        return match ($this) {
            self::DRAFT => [self::PUBLISHED, self::SUSPENDED, self::FAILED],
            self::PUBLISHED => [self::PREPARING, self::SUSPENDED, self::FAILED],
            self::PREPARING => [self::READY, self::FAILED, self::SUSPENDED],
            self::READY => [self::LIVE, self::FAILED, self::SUSPENDED],
            self::LIVE => [self::ENDED, self::FAILED, self::SUSPENDED, self::READY],
            self::ENDED => [self::FAILED, self::SUSPENDED],
            self::FAILED => [self::PREPARING, self::SUSPENDED],
            self::SUSPENDED => [],
        };
    }

    public function canTransitionTo(self $next): bool
    {
        return in_array($next, $this->transitionsTo(), strict: true);
    }

    /** SUSPENDED is reachable from any non-SUSPENDED state. */
    public function canBeSuspendedFrom(): bool
    {
        return $this !== self::SUSPENDED;
    }

    /** True when the event row's core metadata is read-only. */
    public function isMetadataLocked(): bool
    {
        return $this !== self::DRAFT;
    }

    /**
     * True when the event must reject new registrations.
     * DRAFT blocks because the landing page is private until PUBLISHED.
     */
    public function blocksRegistration(): bool
    {
        return in_array($this, [self::DRAFT, self::ENDED, self::FAILED, self::SUSPENDED], strict: true);
    }

    /**
     * Story 5-14 — True when the event is in a state that supports live
     * streaming operations (control room, go-live, end-event).
     *
     * Single source of truth for the READY|LIVE check previously duplicated
     * across EventActionAvailability, ControlRoomController::isOperable,
     * and StreamingLifecycleService claim methods.
     */
    public function isLiveOperable(): bool
    {
        return $this === self::READY || $this === self::LIVE;
    }

    /**
     * Story 5-14 — True when the event has reached the terminal ENDED state.
     */
    public function isEnded(): bool
    {
        return $this === self::ENDED;
    }

    /** Translation key for UI label. Resolves through __() at render-time. */
    public function label(): string
    {
        return __('events.state.' . $this->value);
    }

    /** @return list<string> */
    public static function values(): array
    {
        return array_map(static fn (self $s) => $s->value, self::cases());
    }

    // ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
    // Story 3-17 — Public visibility helpers
    // ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

    /**
     * Is the event completely hidden from public visitors?
     * DRAFT and FAILED events are never publicly addressable, regardless of
     * cancellation state. Cancelled-DRAFT is covered by DRAFT.
     */
    public function isPubliclyHidden(): bool
    {
        return in_array($this, [self::DRAFT, self::FAILED], strict: true);
    }

    /**
     * Which public page shell should render?
     *
     * S3-4-F3 — This is a two-level dispatch: shellFor() selects the public page
     * mode (landing/cancelled/suspended), then the Blade second-level dispatch
     * selects the viewer sub-shell via registrantViewerMode().
     *
     * @param bool $cancelled Whether cancelled_at is set on the event row
     */
    public function publicShell(bool $cancelled): string
    {
        if ($cancelled) {
            return 'cancelled';
        }

        return match ($this) {
            self::SUSPENDED => 'suspended',
            default => 'landing',
        };
    }

    /**
     * Which viewer sub-shell should render when a registrant is authenticated?
     * Returns null for states where registrant viewer access is not applicable.
     *
     * @return ?string 'registered' | 'live' | 'ended' | null
     */
    public function registrantViewerMode(): ?string
    {
        return match ($this) {
            self::PUBLISHED,
            self::PREPARING,
            self::READY => 'registered',
            self::LIVE => 'live',
            self::ENDED => 'ended',
            default => null,
        };
    }

    /**
     * Is this event eligible for public indexing (sitemap, registrant access links)?
     *
     * @param bool $cancelled Whether cancelled_at is set on the event row
     */
    public function isPubliclyIndexable(bool $cancelled): bool
    {
        if ($cancelled) {
            return false;
        }

        return in_array($this, [
            self::PUBLISHED,
            self::PREPARING,
            self::READY,
            self::LIVE,
            self::ENDED,
        ], strict: true);
    }
}

<?php

declare(strict_types=1);

namespace App\Modules\Events\Services;

use App\Models\User;
use App\Modules\Events\Contracts\Repositories\EventRepositoryInterface;
use App\Modules\Events\Enums\EventState;
use App\Modules\Events\Events\EventStateTransitioned;
use App\Modules\Events\Exceptions\EventStateLocked;
use App\Modules\Events\Exceptions\IllegalStateTransition;
use App\Modules\Events\Models\Event;
use Illuminate\Support\Facades\DB;
use Illuminate\Support\Facades\Event as EventDispatcher;
use Platform\AuditLogging\Contracts\AuditLoggerInterface;
use App\Modules\Events\Support\EventAuditEvents;

/**
 * Epic 2 refactor — state-machine hub extracted from EventService.
 *
 * Move-only: transition() and authorizeEventTransition() are byte-for-byte
 * from EventService L1331–L1474. The only edits inside the moved bodies are
 * mechanical rewrites of $this->X(...) calls onto explicit collaborator fields.
 *
 * Extracted first because publish/forceEnd delegate to transition(), making
 * this the dependency hub for all lifecycle/moderation clusters.
 */
class EventStateMachineService
{
    public function __construct(
        private readonly AuditLoggerInterface $auditLogger,
        private readonly EventRepositoryInterface $events,
        private readonly EventAuthorizationService $authz,
    ) {}

    /**
     * Story 2-3a — central state-transition method.
     *
     * Concurrency contract (R-002):
     *   1. lockForUpdate the event row (events row only — no nested locks).
     *   2. Re-read state inside the lock.
     *   3. Re-check `cancelled_at IS NULL` — cancellation always wins forward transitions (§10 Q2).
     *   4. Same-state? No-op return — supports double-click + scheduler retry idempotency.
     *   5. Validate canTransitionTo; if illegal, emit `event.transition_denied` audit then throw.
     *   6. Write state + audit row in same tx.
     *   7. Dispatch domain event AFTER tx commits (post-commit only).
     *
     * Race-sim coverage (P0 race pairs) is exercised by
     * tests/Feature/Events/EventRaceTest using the EventRaceSimulator fixture.
     */
    public function transition(
        Event $event,
        EventState $next,
        User $actor,
        string $reason = '',
        bool $allowForceEndAuthority = false,
    ): Event
    {
        // R1 BLOCKER #1 — service-layer Gate assertion (Rule 30 + Epic 1 canon).
        // Provider-context system actors are admitted via events.update.global;
        // user-context callers need events.update.team OR a Gate-allowed
        // provider grant. Per-target capabilities (one per
        // EventState value) are deferred — they'd need 7 cap rows per role and
        // add no real safety beyond the wrapper checks (publish/suspend/cancel
        // each layer their own gate). Rationale tracked in story Completion Notes.
        $this->authorizeEventTransition($event, $next, $actor, $allowForceEndAuthority);

        // R2 BLOCKER #2 — separate-tx pattern for denied audit.
        // Outer tx ONLY locks + reads + (on legal edge) writes state + audit.
        // Denied path returns the 'denied' signal WITHOUT touching the audit;
        // the verifier emits the denied audit in its OWN transaction outside
        // the closure (so a logger throw rolls back ONLY the audit savepoint
        // and never masks the IllegalStateTransition that follows).
        // R1 HIGH #4 — drop TeamScope inside the service: the Gate above
        // enforces tenancy explicitly, so falling-through to ModelNotFoundException
        // (404) when a SystemAdmin acts cross-team would be wrong.
        $result = DB::transaction(function () use ($event, $next, $actor, $reason): array {
            $fresh = $this->events->lockEventForServiceWrite($event->getKey());

            // R1 HIGH #3 — cancellation re-check ABOVE same-state.
            // A same-state call on a cancelled event must throw, not silently no-op.
            if ($fresh->cancelled_at !== null) {
                throw EventStateLocked::for($fresh);
            }

            if ($fresh->state === $next) {
                return [$fresh, $fresh->state, 'noop'];
            }

            if (! $fresh->state->canTransitionTo($next)) {
                // Do NOT log here — the closure-throw + DB::transaction would
                // rollback any audit row we wrote AND re-raise the logger's
                // RuntimeException, masking IllegalStateTransition. Bubble
                // the decision out and let the post-tx block handle it.
                return [$fresh, $fresh->state, 'denied'];
            }

            $from = $fresh->state;
            $fresh->state = $next;
            $fresh->save();

            // Success-path audit MUST stay inside the outer tx (AC1 invariant:
            // state mutation + audit emission are atomic; logger throw rolls
            // back state). Tested by `domain_event_is_not_dispatched_when_transaction_rolls_back`.
            $this->auditLogger->log(
                event: EventAuditEvents::EVENT_TRANSITIONED,
                description: "Event {$fresh->getKey()} transitioned {$from->value} -> {$next->value}",
                subject: $actor,
                target: $fresh,
                properties: [
                    'team_id' => $fresh->team_id,
                    'event_uuid' => $fresh->uuid,
                    'from' => $from->value,
                    'to' => $next->value,
                    'reason' => $reason,
                ],
            );

            return [$fresh, $from, 'changed'];
        });

        [$fresh, $from, $outcome] = $result;

        if ($outcome === 'denied') {
            // R2 BLOCKER #2 — emit denied audit in a SEPARATE tx so a logger
            // throw rolls back ONLY this audit (not any prior writes — outer tx
            // already committed cleanly with no writes). Catch any logger
            // failure with `report()` and ALWAYS throw IllegalStateTransition,
            // so the state-machine outcome is never masked by audit-storage.
            try {
                DB::transaction(function () use ($fresh, $next, $actor, $reason): void {
                    $this->auditLogger->log(
                        event: EventAuditEvents::EVENT_TRANSITION_DENIED,
                        description: "Event {$fresh->getKey()} transition denied {$fresh->state->value} -> {$next->value}",
                        subject: $actor,
                        target: $fresh,
                        properties: [
                            'team_id' => $fresh->team_id,
                            'event_uuid' => $fresh->uuid,
                            'from' => $fresh->state->value,
                            'to_attempted' => $next->value,
                            'reason' => $reason,
                        ],
                    );
                });
            } catch (\Throwable $auditFailure) {
                // Best-effort: log the audit-storage failure but do NOT mask
                // the state-machine outcome. The caller still gets the
                // semantically-correct exception type.
                if (function_exists('report')) {
                    report($auditFailure);
                } else {
                    error_log('[EventStateMachineService] denied-audit storage failure: '.$auditFailure->getMessage());
                }
            }

            throw IllegalStateTransition::between($from, $next);
        }

        // Post-commit dispatch — never inside the tx (Epic 1 R8-H1 lesson).
        // DB::afterCommit() queues until the OUTERMOST tx commits, so a caller
        // wrapping transition() in their own DB::transaction() that later rolls
        // back does NOT see the dispatch fire. Without this, the inner-tx
        // commit triggers immediately even when an outer tx rolls back. Pinned
        // by `tests/Feature/Events/Domain/EventDomainEventDispatchOrderTest`.
        if ($outcome === 'changed') {
            DB::afterCommit(static fn () => EventDispatcher::dispatch(
                new EventStateTransitioned($fresh, $from, $next, $actor),
            ));
        }

        return $fresh;
    }

    /**
     * Service-layer transition authorization.
     *
     * Delegates to EventAuthorizationService — single source of truth. The
     * general path requires update authority; the force-end bypass is available
     * only when the forceEnd wrapper passes the explicit context flag.
     */
    public function authorizeEventTransition(
        Event $event,
        EventState $next,
        User $actor,
        bool $allowForceEndAuthority = false,
    ): void
    {
        if ($allowForceEndAuthority) {
            $this->authz->authorizeForceEndTransition($event, $next, $actor);

            return;
        }

        $this->authz->authorizeTransition($event, $actor);
    }
}

     * Concurrency contract (R-002):
     *   1. lockForUpdate the event row (events row only — no nested locks).
     *   2. Re-read state inside the lock.
     *   3. Re-check `cancelled_at IS NULL` — cancellation always wins forward transitions (§10 Q2).
     *   4. Same-state? No-op return — supports double-click + scheduler retry idempotency.
     *   5. Validate canTransitionTo; if illegal, emit `event.transition_denied` audit then throw.
     *   6. Write state + audit row in same tx.
     *   7. Dispatch domain event AFTER tx commits (post-commit only).
     *
     * Race-sim coverage (P0 race pairs) is exercised by
     * tests/Feature/Events/EventRaceTest using the EventRaceSimulator fixture.
     */
    public function transition(
        Event $event,
        EventState $next,
        User $actor,
        string $reason = '',
        bool $allowForceEndAuthority = false,
    ): Event
    {
        // R1 BLOCKER #1 — service-layer Gate assertion (Rule 30 + Epic 1 canon).
        // Provider-context system actors are admitted via events.update.global;
        // user-context callers need events.update.team OR a Gate-allowed
        // provider grant. Per-target capabilities (one per
        // EventState value) are deferred — they'd need 7 cap rows per role and
        // add no real safety beyond the wrapper checks (publish/suspend/cancel
        // each layer their own gate). Rationale tracked in story Completion Notes.
        $this->authorizeEventTransition($event, $next, $actor, $allowForceEndAuthority);

        // R2 BLOCKER #2 — separate-tx pattern for denied audit.
        // Outer tx ONLY locks + reads + (on legal edge) writes state + audit.
        // Denied path returns the 'denied' signal WITHOUT touching the audit;
        // the verifier emits the denied audit in its OWN transaction outside
        // the closure (so a logger throw rolls back ONLY the audit savepoint
        // and never masks the IllegalStateTransition that follows).
        // R1 HIGH #4 — drop TeamScope inside the service: the Gate above
        // enforces tenancy explicitly, so falling-through to ModelNotFoundException
        // (404) when a SystemAdmin acts cross-team would be wrong.
        $result = DB::transaction(function () use ($event, $next, $actor, $reason): array {
            $fresh = $this->events->lockEventForServiceWrite($event->getKey());

            // R1 HIGH #3 — cancellation re-check ABOVE same-state.
            // A same-state call on a cancelled event must throw, not silently no-op.
            if ($fresh->cancelled_at !== null) {
                throw EventStateLocked::for($fresh);
            }

            if ($fresh->state === $next) {
                return [$fresh, $fresh->state, 'noop'];
            }

            if (! $fresh->state->canTransitionTo($next)) {
                // Do NOT log here — the closure-throw + DB::transaction would
                // rollback any audit row we wrote AND re-raise the logger's
                // RuntimeException, masking IllegalStateTransition. Bubble
                // the decision out and let the post-tx block handle it.
                return [$fresh, $fresh->state, 'denied'];
            }

            $from = $fresh->state;
            $fresh->state = $next;
            $fresh->save();

            // Success-path audit MUST stay inside the outer tx (AC1 invariant:
            // state mutation + audit emission are atomic; logger throw rolls
            // back state). Tested by `domain_event_is_not_dispatched_when_transaction_rolls_back`.
            $this->auditLogger->log(
                event: EventAuditEvents::EVENT_TRANSITIONED,
                description: "Event {$fresh->getKey()} transitioned {$from->value} -> {$next->value}",
                subject: $actor,
                target: $fresh,
                properties: [
                    'team_id' => $fresh->team_id,
                    'event_uuid' => $fresh->uuid,
                    'from' => $from->value,
                    'to' => $next->value,
                    'reason' => $reason,
                ],
            );

            return [$fresh, $from, 'changed'];
        });

        [$fresh, $from, $outcome] = $result;

        if ($outcome === 'denied') {
            // R2 BLOCKER #2 — emit denied audit in a SEPARATE tx so a logger
            // throw rolls back ONLY this audit (not any prior writes — outer tx
            // already committed cleanly with no writes). Catch any logger
            // failure with `report()` and ALWAYS throw IllegalStateTransition,
            // so the state-machine outcome is never masked by audit-storage.
            try {
                DB::transaction(function () use ($fresh, $next, $actor, $reason): void {
                    $this->auditLogger->log(
                        event: EventAuditEvents::EVENT_TRANSITION_DENIED,
                        description: "Event {$fresh->getKey()} transition denied {$fresh->state->value} -> {$next->value}",
                        subject: $actor,
                        target: $fresh,
                        properties: [
                            'team_id' => $fresh->team_id,
                            'event_uuid' => $fresh->uuid,
                            'from' => $fresh->state->value,
                            'to_attempted' => $next->value,
                            'reason' => $reason,
                        ],
                    );
                });
            } catch (\Throwable $auditFailure) {
                // Best-effort: log the audit-storage failure but do NOT mask
                // the state-machine outcome. The caller still gets the
                // semantically-correct exception type.
                if (function_exists('report')) {
                    report($auditFailure);
                } else {
                    error_log('[EventStateMachineService] denied-audit storage failure: '.$auditFailure->getMessage());
                }
            }

            throw IllegalStateTransition::between($from, $next);
        }

        // Post-commit dispatch — never inside the tx (Epic 1 R8-H1 lesson).
        // DB::afterCommit() queues until the OUTERMOST tx commits, so a caller
        // wrapping transition() in their own DB::transaction() that later rolls
        // back does NOT see the dispatch fire. Without this, the inner-tx
        // commit triggers immediately even when an outer tx rolls back. Pinned
        // by `tests/Feature/Events/Domain/EventDomainEventDispatchOrderTest`.
        if ($outcome === 'changed') {
            DB::afterCommit(static fn () => EventDispatcher::dispatch(
                new EventStateTransitioned($fresh, $from, $next, $actor),
            ));
        }

        return $fresh;
    }

    /**
     * Service-layer transition authorization.
     *
     * Delegates to EventAuthorizationService — single source of truth. The
     * general path requires update authority; the force-end bypass is available
     * only when the forceEnd wrapper passes the explicit context flag.
     */
    public function authorizeEventTransition(
        Event $event,
        EventState $next,
        User $actor,
        bool $allowForceEndAuthority = false,
    ): void
    {
        if ($allowForceEndAuthority) {
            $this->authz->authorizeForceEndTransition($event, $next, $actor);

            return;
        }

        $this->authz->authorizeTransition($event, $actor);
    }
}

<?php

declare(strict_types=1);

namespace App\Modules\Events\Services;

use App\Models\Team;
use App\Models\User;
use App\Modules\Events\Enums\EventState;
use App\Modules\Events\Exceptions\EventStateLocked;
use App\Modules\Events\Models\Event;
use App\Modules\Events\Models\LandingPage;
use App\Modules\Events\Models\Registration;
use Illuminate\Auth\Access\AuthorizationException;
use Illuminate\Contracts\Pagination\LengthAwarePaginator;
use Illuminate\Support\Collection;

/**
 * Story 2-1 — central service for the Event domain.
 *
 * Phase 1 surface in this story: createDraft only. Subsequent stories
 * (2-2, 2-3a, 2-3b, 2-5, 2-6) extend this service with updateMetadata,
 * transition, publish (wrapper), cancel, suspend, reactivate.
 */
class EventService
{
    public function __construct(
        private readonly EventAuthorizationService $authz,
        private readonly EventReadService $reader,
        private readonly EventStateMachineService $stateMachine,
        private readonly EventModerationService $moderation,
        private readonly EventLifecycleService $lifecycle,
        private readonly EventMetadataService $metadata,
        private readonly EventLandingService $landing,
        private readonly PublicRegistrationService $publicRegistration,
        private readonly PublicLandingService $publicLanding,
    ) {}

    public function getById(int $id): Event
    {
        return $this->reader->getById($id);
    }

    /** @param array{search?: string|null, date_from?: string|null, date_to?: string|null} $filters */
    public function getPaginatedByTab(string $tab, int $perPage = 25, array $filters = []): LengthAwarePaginator
    {
        return $this->reader->getPaginatedByTab($tab, $perPage, $filters);
    }

    /** @return Collection<int, Event> */
    public function getDashboardEventsForTeam(Team $team, int $limit = 5): Collection
    {
        return $this->reader->getDashboardEventsForTeam($team, $limit);
    }

    public function countEventsForTeam(Team $team): int
    {
        return $this->reader->countEventsForTeam($team);
    }

    public function countUpcomingEventsForTeam(Team $team): int
    {
        return $this->reader->countUpcomingEventsForTeam($team);
    }

    /**
     * Delegates to EventAuthorizationService::authorizeView.
     * Kept as a public method so EventController::show() and the edit flow
     * can call it without knowing the authz service directly.
     *
     * @throws AuthorizationException
     */
    public function authorizeViewAccess(Event $event, User $actor): void
    {
        $this->authz->authorizeView($event, $actor);
    }

    /**
     * List-access guard: actor may list events in their current team.
     *
     * Delegates to EventAuthorizationService::authorizeViewAny, which preserves
     * the current EventPolicy::viewAny behavior (events.view.global or events.view.team).
     *
     * @throws AuthorizationException
     */
    public function authorizeListAccess(User $actor): void
    {
        $team = $actor->currentTeam;

        if ($team === null) {
            throw new AuthorizationException('A team context is required to list events.');
        }

        $this->authz->authorizeViewAny($team, $actor);
    }

    /**
     * Combined edit-form guard: view capability + update capability + state check.
     * The state check (DRAFT + not cancelled) is NOT a capability — it stays here.
     *
     * @throws AuthorizationException
     * @throws EventStateLocked
     */
    public function authorizeEditFormAccess(Event $event, User $actor): void
    {
        $this->authz->authorizeView($event, $actor);
        $this->metadata->authorizeEventUpdate($event->team, $actor);

        if ($event->state !== EventState::DRAFT || $event->cancelled_at !== null) {
            throw EventStateLocked::for($event);
        }
    }

    /**
     * Landing/form-config guard: view + update capability, allows DRAFT|PUBLISHED.
     *
     * LandingSetup, LandingPreview, and RegistrationFormConfig surfaces are
     * writable in both DRAFT and PUBLISHED states, unlike the stricter
     * authorizeEditFormAccess which only allows DRAFT.
     *
     * @throws AuthorizationException
     */
    public function authorizeLandingFormAccess(Event $event, User $actor): void
    {
        $this->authz->authorizeView($event, $actor);
        $this->metadata->authorizeEventUpdate($event->team, $actor);
    }

    /**
     * Prepare-checklist guard: view + update capability.
     *
     * The prepare checklist is accessible in PUBLISHED state (it's the gate
     * to transition PUBLISHED→PREPARING). State validation is handled inside
     * EventStateMachineService during the actual prepare() call, not at the
     * component guard level.
     *
     * @throws AuthorizationException
     */
    public function authorizePrepareAccess(Event $event, User $actor): void
    {
        $this->authz->authorizeView($event, $actor);
        $this->metadata->authorizeEventUpdate($event->team, $actor);
    }

    /**
     * @param  array<string, mixed>  $metadata
     */
    public function createDraft(Team $team, User $actor, array $metadata): Event
    {
        return $this->metadata->createDraft($team, $actor, $metadata);
    }

    /**
     * Story 2-3b — Publish (DRAFT → PUBLISHED) with plan-gate triple-lock.
     *
     * Layer 3 of the triple-lock (FR80 / AR17): the service MUST re-check the
     * EVENT_PUBLISH entitlement even after the route capability + UI gate.
     * If the event team's plan does not grant PUBLISH, throws
     * PlanGateFailed (HTTP 402, JKM-EVT-1003).
     *
     * Idempotency comes for free from `transition()`'s same-state no-op.
     * Cancellation blocking comes from `transition()`'s cancelled_at re-read.
     */
    public function publish(Event $event, User $actor): Event
    {
        return $this->lifecycle->publish($event, $actor);
    }

    /** @return array{allowed: bool, reason: string|null} */
    public function publishReadiness(Event $event, ?User $actor): array
    {
        return $this->lifecycle->publishReadiness($event, $actor);
    }

    /** @param  array<string, mixed>  $payload */
    public function upsertLandingSetup(Event $event, User $actor, array $payload): LandingPage
    {
        return $this->landing->upsertLandingSetup($event, $actor, $payload);
    }

    /** @param  array<string, mixed>  $payload */
    public function upsertRegistrationFormConfig(Event $event, User $actor, array $payload): LandingPage
    {
        return $this->landing->upsertRegistrationFormConfig($event, $actor, $payload);
    }
    /** @param array<string, mixed> $payload */
    public function submitPublicRegistration(Event $event, array $payload, ?string $ipAddress): array
    {
        return $this->publicRegistration->submitPublicRegistration($event, $payload, $ipAddress);
    }

    /**
     * Story 4-17 — Resolve an Event by UUID for the delivery-logs surface.
     *
     * TeamScope bypass category: Authorization resolution — the route uses a plain
     * string parameter so TeamScope does not kill cross-team requests with 404 before
     * authorization runs. The event is found, then authorizeView enforces the team
     * boundary (403 for non-members, 200 for entitled members, bypass for SA).
     *
     * @throws \Symfony\Component\HttpKernel\Exception\HttpException 404 if no event with this UUID, 403 if not authorized.
     */
    public function resolveAndAuthorizeForDeliveryLogs(string $uuid, User $actor): Event
    {
        $event = Event::withoutGlobalScope(\App\Scopes\TeamScope::class)
            ->where('uuid', $uuid)
            ->firstOrFail();

        $this->authz->authorizeView($event, $actor);

        return $event;
    }

    public function findPublicRegistrationSupportEvent(string $eventUuid): ?Event
    {
        return $this->publicLanding->findPublicRegistrationSupportEvent($eventUuid);
    }

    public function findPublicLandingEvent(string $eventUuid): ?Event
    {
        return $this->publicLanding->findPublicLandingEvent($eventUuid);
    }

    public function findPublicRegistrant(Event $event, string $registrationUuid): ?Registration
    {
        return $this->publicRegistration->findPublicRegistrant($event, $registrationUuid);
    }

    public function resendPublicRegistrationConfirmation(Event $event, string $email, ?string $ipAddress = null): bool
    {
        return $this->publicRegistration->resendPublicRegistrationConfirmation($event, $email, $ipAddress);
    }

    public function suspend(Event $event, User $actor, string $reason): Event
    {
        return $this->moderation->suspend($event, $actor, $reason);
    }

    public function reactivate(Event $event, User $actor, string $reason = ''): Event
    {
        return $this->moderation->reactivate($event, $actor, $reason);
    }

    public function forceEnd(Event $event, User $actor): Event
    {
        return $this->moderation->forceEnd($event, $actor);
    }

    /** @return array{visible: bool, can_suspend: bool, can_reactivate: bool, can_force_end: bool} */
    public function moderationActions(Event $event, User $actor): array
    {
        return $this->moderation->moderationActions($event, $actor);
    }

    public function cancel(Event $event, User $actor, string $reason): Event
    {
        return $this->lifecycle->cancel($event, $actor, $reason);
    }

    public function transition(Event $event, EventState $next, User $actor, string $reason = ''): Event
    {
        return $this->stateMachine->transition($event, $next, $actor, $reason);
    }

    /** @param  array<string, mixed>  $changes */
    public function updateMetadata(Event $event, User $actor, array $changes): Event
    {
        return $this->metadata->updateMetadata($event, $actor, $changes);
    }
}

     * PlanGateFailed (HTTP 402, JKM-EVT-1003).

     *

     * string parameter so TeamScope does not kill cross-team requests with 404 before

     * boundary (403 for non-members, 200 for entitled members, bypass for SA).

            ->where('uuid', $uuid)
            ->firstOrFail();

        $this->authz->authorizeView($event, $actor);

        return $event;
    }

    public function findPublicRegistrationSupportEvent(string $eventUuid): ?Event
    {
        return $this->publicLanding->findPublicRegistrationSupportEvent($eventUuid);
    }

    public function findPublicLandingEvent(string $eventUuid): ?Event
    {
        return $this->publicLanding->findPublicLandingEvent($eventUuid);
    }

    public function findPublicRegistrant(Event $event, string $registrationUuid): ?Registration
    {
        return $this->publicRegistration->findPublicRegistrant($event, $registrationUuid);
    }

    public function resendPublicRegistrationConfirmation(Event $event, string $email, ?string $ipAddress = null): bool
    {
        return $this->publicRegistration->resendPublicRegistrationConfirmation($event, $email, $ipAddress);
    }

    public function suspend(Event $event, User $actor, string $reason): Event
    {
        return $this->moderation->suspend($event, $actor, $reason);
    }

    public function reactivate(Event $event, User $actor, string $reason = ''): Event
    {
        return $this->moderation->reactivate($event, $actor, $reason);
    }

    public function forceEnd(Event $event, User $actor): Event
    {
        return $this->moderation->forceEnd($event, $actor);
    }

    /** @return array{visible: bool, can_suspend: bool, can_reactivate: bool, can_force_end: bool} */
    public function moderationActions(Event $event, User $actor): array
    {
        return $this->moderation->moderationActions($event, $actor);
    }

    {
        return $this->lifecycle->cancel($event, $actor, $reason);

    {
        return $this->stateMachine->transition($event, $next, $actor, $reason);
    }

    public function updateMetadata(Event $event, User $actor, array $changes): Event
    {
        return $this->metadata->updateMetadata($event, $actor, $changes);
    }

use App\Modules\Events\Contracts\Repositories\EventRepositoryInterface;

use App\Modules\Events\Enums\EventState;
use App\Modules\Events\Events\EventCancelled;
use App\Modules\Events\Exceptions\EventOperationalLockActive;
use App\Modules\Events\Exceptions\EventStateLocked;
use App\Modules\Events\Exceptions\IllegalStateTransition;
use App\Modules\Events\Exceptions\PlanGateFailed;
use App\Modules\Events\Exceptions\PublishPrerequisiteMissing;
use App\Modules\Events\Models\Event;
use App\Modules\Events\Support\EventAuditEvents;
use App\Scopes\TeamScope;
use App\Services\PlatformKillSwitchService;
use Illuminate\Support\Facades\DB;
use Illuminate\Support\Facades\Event as EventDispatcher;
use Platform\AuditLogging\Contracts\AuditLoggerInterface;

/**
 * Epic 2 refactor — lifecycle cluster extracted from EventService (publish + cancel).
 *
 * Move-only: all bodies are byte-for-byte from EventService.
 * Mechanical rewrites:
 *   - $this->transition(...) → $this->stateMachine->transition(...) in publish() (1 site)
 *   - $this->authorizeEventPublish(...) → $this->authorizeEventPublish(...) (stays private here)
 *   - $this->authorizeEventCancel(...) → $this->authorizeEventCancel(...) (stays private here)
 *   - $this->entitlements → $this->entitlements (promoted to constructor param)
 * Error-log tag updated: '[EventService]' → '[EventLifecycleService]'.
 */
class EventLifecycleService
{
    public const PUBLISH_REASON_PLAN_GATE = 'plan_gate';

    public function __construct(
        private readonly AuditLoggerInterface $auditLogger,
        private readonly EntitlementChecker $entitlements,
        private readonly EventRepositoryInterface $events,
        private readonly EventStateMachineService $stateMachine,
        private readonly EventAuthorizationService $authz,
        private readonly AiAuditRequestService $aiAuditRequests,
        private readonly PlatformKillSwitchService $killSwitches,
        private readonly EventOperationalLockService $operationalLocks,
    ) {}

    public function publish(Event $event, User $actor): Event
    {
        // R1 BLOCKER #1 (2-3b) — service-layer Gate.
        // events.publish.team is Admin-only (per AC5: Co-host CANNOT publish).
        // This MUST run before the entitlement check so a Co-host on a Pro
        // plan does not fall through into transition() via events.update.team.
        // Entitlement/plan-gate check is NOT here — it stays in publish() after this call.
        $this->authz->authorizePublish($event, $actor);

        $this->assertMutablePublishPrerequisites($event, $actor);

        if ($event->state === EventState::PUBLISHED) {
            return $this->stateMachine->transition($event, EventState::PUBLISHED, $actor, 'admin.publish');
        }

        // Phase 1: the explicit organizer command may create/reuse and
        // synchronously triage the current snapshot. Provider I/O happens
        // before any event transaction or event-row lock.
        $decision = $this->aiAuditRequests->ensureCurrentPublishDecisionOrRequest($event);

        if (! $decision->isApproved()) {
            throw PublishPrerequisiteMissing::aiAudit($event, $decision->status);
        }

        // Provider latency creates a new authorization boundary. Reload the
        // actor/team context and invalidate its supported permission cache
        // before re-running the publish capability guard. Authorization must
        // remain outside every transaction and row lock.
        $freshActor = User::query()
            ->with('currentTeam')
            ->findOrFail($actor->getKey());
        $freshActor->clearAllPermissionCache();
        $this->authz->authorizePublish($event, $freshActor);

        // Phase 2: serialize content writers on the event row, reload every
        // mutable gate, and recompute the E-AIA-owned current-snapshot result.
        // EventStateMachineService remains the sole state writer and owns the
        // atomic transition audit plus after-commit domain event.
        return DB::transaction(function () use ($event, $freshActor): Event {
            $fresh = $this->events->lockEventForServiceWrite($event->getKey());

            if ($fresh->state === EventState::PUBLISHED) {
                return $fresh;
            }

            $this->assertMutablePublishPrerequisites($fresh, $freshActor, freshEntitlement: true);

            $finalDecision = $this->aiAuditRequests->lockCurrentPublishDecisionForEvent($fresh);

            if (! $finalDecision->isApproved()) {
                throw PublishPrerequisiteMissing::aiAudit($fresh, $finalDecision->status);
            }

            return $this->stateMachine->transition($fresh, EventState::PUBLISHED, $freshActor, 'admin.publish');
        }, attempts: 1);
    }

    private function assertMutablePublishPrerequisites(
        Event $event,
        User $actor,
        bool $freshEntitlement = false,
    ): void {
        if ($this->killSwitches->active(PlatformKillSwitchKey::PUBLISH)) {
            throw new PlatformKillSwitchActiveException(PlatformKillSwitchKey::PUBLISH);
        }

        if ($this->operationalLocks->active($event, EventOperationalLockKey::PUBLISH)) {
            throw new EventOperationalLockActive($event, EventOperationalLockKey::PUBLISH);
        }

        $hasPublishEntitlement = $freshEntitlement
            ? $this->entitlements->hasFreshEntitlementForTeam($actor, $event->team_id, 'PUBLISH')
            : $this->entitlements->hasEntitlementForTeam($actor, $event->team_id, 'PUBLISH');

        if (! $hasPublishEntitlement) {
            throw PlanGateFailed::for($event, 'PUBLISH');
        }

        if ($event->cancelled_at !== null) {
            throw EventStateLocked::for($event);
        }

        if (! in_array($event->state, [EventState::DRAFT, EventState::PUBLISHED], strict: true)) {
            throw IllegalStateTransition::between($event->state, EventState::PUBLISHED);
        }

<?php

declare(strict_types=1);

namespace Tests\Unit\Events;

use App\Modules\Events\Enums\EventState;
use PHPUnit\Framework\Attributes\DataProvider;
use PHPUnit\Framework\Attributes\Test;
use Tests\TestCase;
use PHPUnit\Framework\Attributes\Group;

/**
 * Story 2-1 ATDD — EventState enum + transition table.
 *
 * Canonical edges read from docs/specs/event-states.md (Reading A,
 * 8-state machine reconciled 2026-04-25 PF-1).
 */
#[Group('events')]
#[Group('p0')]
class EventStateTest extends TestCase
{
    #[Test]
    public function enum_has_exactly_eight_cases(): void
    {
        $this->assertCount(8, EventState::cases());
    }

    #[Test]
    public function canonical_state_values_are_lowercase_strings(): void
    {
        $expected = ['draft', 'published', 'preparing', 'ready', 'live', 'ended', 'failed', 'suspended'];
        $actual = array_map(fn (EventState $s) => $s->value, EventState::cases());
        sort($expected);
        sort($actual);
        $this->assertSame($expected, $actual);
    }

    /**
     * @return iterable<string, array{0: EventState, 1: EventState, 2: bool}>
     */
    public static function transitionTableProvider(): iterable
    {
        // Legal edges from docs/specs/event-states.md (19 edges total).
        $legal = [
            [EventState::DRAFT, EventState::PUBLISHED],
            [EventState::DRAFT, EventState::SUSPENDED],
            [EventState::DRAFT, EventState::FAILED],
            [EventState::PUBLISHED, EventState::PREPARING],
            [EventState::PUBLISHED, EventState::SUSPENDED],
            [EventState::PUBLISHED, EventState::FAILED],
            [EventState::PREPARING, EventState::READY],
            [EventState::PREPARING, EventState::FAILED],
            [EventState::PREPARING, EventState::SUSPENDED],
            [EventState::READY, EventState::LIVE],
            [EventState::READY, EventState::FAILED],
            [EventState::READY, EventState::SUSPENDED],
            [EventState::LIVE, EventState::ENDED],
            [EventState::LIVE, EventState::FAILED],
            [EventState::LIVE, EventState::SUSPENDED],
            [EventState::ENDED, EventState::FAILED],
            [EventState::ENDED, EventState::SUSPENDED],
            [EventState::FAILED, EventState::PREPARING],
            [EventState::FAILED, EventState::SUSPENDED],
        ];

        foreach ($legal as [$from, $to]) {
            yield "{$from->value} -> {$to->value} legal" => [$from, $to, true];
        }

        // A few illegal edges (parametric over complement is too big to enumerate; spot-check).
        $illegal = [
            [EventState::DRAFT, EventState::PREPARING], // can't skip PUBLISHED
            [EventState::DRAFT, EventState::READY],
            [EventState::DRAFT, EventState::LIVE],
            [EventState::DRAFT, EventState::ENDED],
            [EventState::PUBLISHED, EventState::READY], // must go through PREPARING
            [EventState::PUBLISHED, EventState::LIVE],
            [EventState::PUBLISHED, EventState::ENDED],
            [EventState::PREPARING, EventState::LIVE], // must go through READY
            [EventState::PREPARING, EventState::ENDED],
            [EventState::READY, EventState::ENDED], // must go through LIVE
            [EventState::ENDED, EventState::LIVE], // no resurrection
            [EventState::ENDED, EventState::READY],
            [EventState::FAILED, EventState::READY], // must restart from PREPARING
            [EventState::FAILED, EventState::LIVE],
            [EventState::SUSPENDED, EventState::DRAFT], // SUSPENDED uses restoreFrom, not transitionsTo
            [EventState::SUSPENDED, EventState::PUBLISHED],
            [EventState::SUSPENDED, EventState::PREPARING],
            [EventState::SUSPENDED, EventState::READY],
            [EventState::SUSPENDED, EventState::LIVE],
            [EventState::SUSPENDED, EventState::ENDED],
            [EventState::SUSPENDED, EventState::FAILED],
        ];

        foreach ($illegal as [$from, $to]) {
            yield "{$from->value} -> {$to->value} illegal" => [$from, $to, false];
        }
    }

    #[Test]
    #[DataProvider('transitionTableProvider')]
    public function transition_table_matches_canonical_edges(EventState $from, EventState $to, bool $legal): void
    {
        $this->assertSame($legal, $from->canTransitionTo($to), "Edge {$from->value} -> {$to->value} expected " . ($legal ? 'legal' : 'illegal'));
    }

    #[Test]
    public function suspended_has_empty_transitions_to_array(): void
    {
        $this->assertSame([], EventState::SUSPENDED->transitionsTo());
    }

    #[Test]
    public function can_be_suspended_from_returns_false_only_for_suspended(): void
    {
        foreach (EventState::cases() as $state) {
            $expected = $state !== EventState::SUSPENDED;
            $this->assertSame($expected, $state->canBeSuspendedFrom(), "{$state->value}->canBeSuspendedFrom() mismatch");
        }
    }

    #[Test]
    public function metadata_is_locked_in_every_state_except_draft(): void
    {
        foreach (EventState::cases() as $state) {
            $expected = $state !== EventState::DRAFT;
            $this->assertSame($expected, $state->isMetadataLocked(), "{$state->value}->isMetadataLocked() mismatch");
        }
    }

            [EventState::ENDED, EventState::READY],
            [EventState::FAILED, EventState::READY], // must restart from PREPARING
            [EventState::FAILED, EventState::LIVE],

    #[Test]
    public function suspended_has_empty_transitions_to_array(): void
    {
        $this->assertSame([], EventState::SUSPENDED->transitionsTo());
    }

    #[Test]
    public function can_be_suspended_from_returns_false_only_for_suspended(): void
    {
        foreach (EventState::cases() as $state) {
            $expected = $state !== EventState::SUSPENDED;
            $this->assertSame($expected, $state->canBeSuspendedFrom(), "{$state->value}->canBeSuspendedFrom() mismatch");

    public function metadata_is_locked_in_every_state_except_draft(): void
    {

            $this->assertSame($expected, $state->isMetadataLocked(), "{$state->value}->isMetadataLocked() mismatch");

 * AC6 (idempotency: same-state no-op).

 * Race-sim (AC2 concurrent) and force-end (AC4) are scoped out of this overnight
 * commit and deferred per story Completion Notes.

{
    use WithAdminEvent;

    protected function setUp(): void
    {
        parent::setUp();
        Cache::flush();

        // FIXUP-2 — Hoist Bus::fake() / Event::fake() into setUp() so denial
        // and parametric paths inherit the same dispatcher isolation as the
        // happy paths. Tests that need to assert "no dispatch" can still call
        // EventFacade::assertNotDispatched(...) — fake() does not preclude that.
        EventFacade::fake([\App\Modules\Events\Events\EventStateTransitioned::class]);
    }

    /**
     * Legal edges driving `EventService::transition()` happy-path coverage.
     *
     * FIXUP-6 divergence note (test-review-epic-2.md):
     *   This provider intentionally enumerates the 12 forward-flow edges that
     *   are reachable through `EventService::transition()`. The 7 `*→SUSPENDED`
     *   edges from the canonical 19-edge state machine are deliberately
     *   omitted here because SUSPENDED is reached via `EventService::suspend()`,
     *   which has its own SystemAdmin authority cap (`events.suspend.global`).
     *   `transition()` does not gate on the suspend cap; adding `*→SUSPENDED`
     *   rows here would either fail (Admin lacks suspend authority on the
     *   service-Gate level) or succeed in a way that documents an authority
     *   bypass — neither is what this provider is for.
     *
     *   Canonical 19-edge truth (legal + illegal complement) is pinned at
     *   the unit level in {@see \Tests\Unit\Events\EventStateTest::transitionTableProvider}.
     *   That table covers every state-machine edge including all `*→SUSPENDED`
     *   and `SUSPENDED→*` rows directly against `EventState::canTransitionTo()`.
     *
     * @return iterable<string, array{0: EventState, 1: EventState}>
     */
    public static function legalEdgeProvider(): iterable
    {
        $edges = [
            [EventState::DRAFT, EventState::PUBLISHED],
            [EventState::DRAFT, EventState::FAILED],
            [EventState::PUBLISHED, EventState::PREPARING],
            [EventState::PUBLISHED, EventState::FAILED],
            [EventState::PREPARING, EventState::READY],
            [EventState::PREPARING, EventState::FAILED],
            [EventState::READY, EventState::LIVE],
            [EventState::READY, EventState::FAILED],
            [EventState::LIVE, EventState::ENDED],
            [EventState::LIVE, EventState::FAILED],
            [EventState::LIVE, EventState::READY], // S5-3-F1 — recording start failure recovery
            [EventState::ENDED, EventState::FAILED],
            [EventState::FAILED, EventState::PREPARING],
        ];

        foreach ($edges as [$from, $to]) {
            yield "{$from->value} -> {$to->value}" => [$from, $to];
        }
    }

    #[Test]
    #[DataProvider('legalEdgeProvider')]
    public function legal_transition_persists_state_and_emits_audit(EventState $from, EventState $to): void
    {
        [$admin, , $event] = $this->adminWithEvent($from);
        EventFacade::fake([EventStateTransitioned::class]);

        $result = app(EventService::class)->transition($event, $to, $admin, 'test');

        $this->assertSame($to, $result->state);

        $this->assertDatabaseHas('activity_log', [
            'log_name' => 'event.transitioned',
            'subject_type' => Event::class,
            'subject_id' => $event->id,
            'causer_id' => $admin->id,
        ]);

        EventFacade::assertDispatched(
            EventStateTransitioned::class,
            fn (EventStateTransitioned $e) => $e->from === $from && $e->to === $to,
        );
    }

            ->assertJsonPath('error.message', __('events.publish.unavailable.operations_locked'));

namespace Tests\Feature\Events\Concerns;

use App\Enums\UserRole;
use App\Models\Team;
use App\Models\User;
use App\Modules\Events\Enums\EventState;
use App\Modules\Events\Models\Event;

/**
 * FIXUP-1 (test-review-epic-2.md) — shared admin+team+event fixture helper.
 *
 * Promotes the previously-duplicated `adminWithEvent($state)` helper out of
 * the per-test classes (CancelEventTest, EditEventTest, EventTransitionTest)
 * into a single concern. Avoids silent divergence if the team-attach logic
 * changes in one file but not another.
 *
 * Scope (per test-review FIXUP-1 + advisor reconcile):
 *   - Three classes use the identical shape: admin user with `current_team_id`
 *     set, attached as ADMIN to a freshly-created team, with an event in the
 *     given state created in that team. `actingAs($admin)` is invoked.
 *   - SpeakerCrudJourneyTest uses `adminWithPlan(PlanTier::GROWTH)` (a billing
 *     fixture, different shape) — NOT a candidate for this trait.
 *   - EventListTest::createAdminWithTeamStatic() is a static (DataProvider)
 *     helper without event creation — NOT a candidate.
 */
trait WithAdminEvent
{
    /**
     * Create an Admin user with their own team and an event in the given state.
     *
     * Bypasses HTTP middleware (service-direct tests) but still calls
     * `actingAs($admin)` so HasTeamScope resolves the tenant context.
     *
     * @return array{0: User, 1: Team, 2: Event}
     */
    private function adminWithEvent(EventState $state = EventState::DRAFT): array
    {
        $user = User::factory()->create();
        $team = Team::factory()->create(['user_id' => $user->id]);

        }
    }

    /**
     * Create the platform's is_system_team team for tests that exercise the
     * grantSystemAdmin / revokeSystemAdmin service paths.
     *
     * The production system team is seeded by SuperadminSeeder; in tests with
     * RefreshDatabase it must be created explicitly before calling the grant
     * service method.
     */
    protected function createSystemTeam(): Team
    {
        $owner = User::factory()->create(['email_verified_at' => now()]);

        /** @var Team $team */
        $team = Team::factory()->create([
            'user_id'         => $owner->id,
            'is_system_team'  => true,
            'personal_team'   => false,
        ]);

        return $team;
    }

    /**

    protected function createWorkspace(array $teamAttributes = []): Team
    {
        $owner = User::factory()->create(['email_verified_at' => now()]);

        $team = Team::factory()
            ->nonPersonal()
            ->create(array_merge(['user_id' => $owner->id], $teamAttributes));

        $team->users()->attach($owner, ['role' => UserRole::ownerDefault()->value]);
        $owner->forceFill(['current_team_id' => $team->id])->save();

        return $freshTeam;
    }

            'current_team_id' => $workspace->id,
        ]);

        return $freshUser;
    }

        $freshUser = $user->fresh(['currentTeam']);

        return $freshUser;
    }

    protected function suspendWorkspace(Team $team): Team
    {
        $team->forceFill(['status' => TeamStatus::SUSPENDED])->save();

        /** @var Team $freshTeam */
        $freshTeam = $team->fresh();

        return $freshTeam;
    }

 * Mirrors Epic 1's `RevolutWebhookEventCatalog` and the Streaming
 * module's `StreamingAuditEvents` — surfaces every `event:` string
 * passed to `$auditLogger->log(...)` from an Epic 2 / Epic 3 service so:
 * 1. Renames are tractable via static analysis.
 * 2. New audit emissions consult the catalog rather than invent strings.
 * 3. Downstream analytics / search treats these as a closed vocabulary.
 *
 * Resolves Pass-2 finding S2-1-F7 / S2-2-F11 family (Events slice).
 * Companion catalog for Streaming module is
 * `app/Modules/Streaming/Support/StreamingAuditEvents.php`.
 *
 * Naming convention: `event.<resource>[_<denied>]`. Denied variants emit
 * separately from a separate-tx in the service so a logger throw cannot
 * mask the EventStateLocked / IllegalStateTransition exception.

/**

{

    ) {}

    {
        if (!$user instanceof PermissionSubjectInterface) {
            return false;
        }

        return $this->evaluator->hasPermission($user, $capability);
    }

        private readonly PermissionEvaluator $evaluator,
    ) {}

    public function hasCapability(Authenticatable $user, string $capability): bool
    {
        if (!$user instanceof PermissionSubjectInterface) {
            return false;
        }

        return $this->evaluator->hasPermission($user, $capability);
    }
}

<?php

declare(strict_types=1);

namespace Tests\Feature\Events;

use App\Enums\UserRole;
use App\Models\Team;
use App\Models\User;
use App\Modules\Events\Enums\EventState;
use App\Modules\Events\Enums\RegistrationSource;
use App\Modules\Events\Models\Event;
use App\Modules\Events\Models\Registration;
use Illuminate\Testing\TestResponse;
use PHPUnit\Framework\Attributes\DataProvider;
use PHPUnit\Framework\Attributes\Group;
use PHPUnit\Framework\Attributes\Test;
use Spatie\Activitylog\Models\Activity;
use Tests\Feature\FeatureTestCase;
use Tests\Feature\SuperAdmin\Support\InteractsWithSuperAdmin;

/**
 * Capsule T6 ATDD — platform-admin revert of a PUBLISHED event back to DRAFT.
 *
 * Asserts the observable contract only: HTTP outcome, persisted state, the
 * audit row the guarded transition path writes, and the canonical
 * legal-transition table the rest of the domain reads.
 */
#[Group('events')]
class AdminRevertToDraftTest extends FeatureTestCase
{
    use InteractsWithSuperAdmin;

    // ---------------------------------------------------------------------
    // AC1 + AC2 — the action exists, is capability-gated, and goes through
    // the guarded transition path (audit record included).
    // ---------------------------------------------------------------------

    #[Test]
    public function platform_admin_reverts_published_event_to_draft_and_records_the_transition(): void
    {
        $workspace = $this->createWorkspace();
        $event = $this->eventFor($workspace, EventState::PUBLISHED);
        $platformAdmin = $this->createPlatformSuperAdmin($workspace);

        $this->actingAs($platformAdmin)
            ->postJson(route('admin.events.revert-to-draft', $event->uuid))
            ->assertOk()
            ->assertJsonPath('data.state', EventState::DRAFT->value);

        $this->assertSame(EventState::DRAFT, $event->refresh()->state);

        $activity = Activity::query()
            ->where('log_name', 'event.transitioned')
            ->where('subject_type', Event::class)
            ->where('subject_id', $event->id)
            ->latest('id')
            ->firstOrFail();

        $this->assertSame($platformAdmin->id, (int) $activity->causer_id);
        $this->assertSame(EventState::PUBLISHED->value, data_get($activity->properties, 'from'));
        $this->assertSame(EventState::DRAFT->value, data_get($activity->properties, 'to'));
    }

    #[Test]
    public function revert_route_is_capability_gated_through_route_permission_config(): void
    {
        $this->assertArrayHasKey(
            'admin.events.revert-to-draft',
            config('route_permissions.routes'),
            'The revert route must be declared in the route-permission configuration.',
        );

        $workspace = $this->createWorkspace();
        $event = $this->eventFor($workspace, EventState::PUBLISHED);
        $workspaceAdmin = $this->createWorkspaceMember($workspace, UserRole::ADMIN);

        $this->actingAs($workspaceAdmin)
            ->postJson(route('admin.events.revert-to-draft', $event->uuid))
            ->assertForbidden();

        $this->assertSame(EventState::PUBLISHED, $event->refresh()->state);
    }

    // ---------------------------------------------------------------------
    // AC3 — only a PUBLISHED event may be reverted.
    // ---------------------------------------------------------------------

    /** @return iterable<string, array{0: EventState}> */
    public static function nonPublishedStateProvider(): iterable
    {
        yield 'draft' => [EventState::DRAFT];
        yield 'preparing' => [EventState::PREPARING];
    }

    #[Test]
    #[DataProvider('nonPublishedStateProvider')]
    public function revert_is_refused_when_the_event_is_not_published(EventState $state): void
    {
        $workspace = $this->createWorkspace();
        $event = $this->eventFor($workspace, $state);
        $platformAdmin = $this->createPlatformSuperAdmin($workspace);

        $response = $this->actingAs($platformAdmin)
            ->postJson(route('admin.events.revert-to-draft', $event->uuid));

        $this->assertRefused($response, $event, $state);
    }

    // ---------------------------------------------------------------------
    // AC4 — registrations block the revert.
    // ---------------------------------------------------------------------

    #[Test]
    public function revert_is_refused_when_the_event_has_registrations(): void
    {
        $workspace = $this->createWorkspace();
        $event = $this->eventFor($workspace, EventState::PUBLISHED);
        $this->registerAttendee($event);
        $platformAdmin = $this->createPlatformSuperAdmin($workspace);

        $response = $this->actingAs($platformAdmin)
            ->postJson(route('admin.events.revert-to-draft', $event->uuid));

        $this->assertRefused($response, $event, EventState::PUBLISHED);
    }

    // ---------------------------------------------------------------------
    // AC5 — cancellation keeps winning over lifecycle moves.
    // ---------------------------------------------------------------------

    #[Test]
    public function revert_is_refused_for_a_cancelled_event(): void
    {
        $workspace = $this->createWorkspace();
        $event = $this->eventFor($workspace, EventState::PUBLISHED, cancelled: true);
        $platformAdmin = $this->createPlatformSuperAdmin($workspace);

        $response = $this->actingAs($platformAdmin)
            ->postJson(route('admin.events.revert-to-draft', $event->uuid));

        $this->assertRefused($response, $event, EventState::PUBLISHED);
        $this->assertNotNull($event->refresh()->cancelled_at);
    }

    // ---------------------------------------------------------------------
    // AC6 — the canonical table gains exactly one edge and nothing else, and
    // the state-derived rules other code reads keep their answers.
    // ---------------------------------------------------------------------

    #[Test]
    public function canonical_transition_table_gains_only_the_published_to_draft_edge(): void
    {
        $expected = [
            'draft' => [EventState::PUBLISHED, EventState::SUSPENDED, EventState::FAILED],
            // PUBLISHED -> DRAFT is the single edge this capsule introduces.
            'published' => [EventState::PREPARING, EventState::SUSPENDED, EventState::FAILED, EventState::DRAFT],
            'preparing' => [EventState::READY, EventState::FAILED, EventState::SUSPENDED],
            'ready' => [EventState::LIVE, EventState::FAILED, EventState::SUSPENDED],
            'live' => [EventState::ENDED, EventState::FAILED, EventState::SUSPENDED, EventState::READY],
            'ended' => [EventState::FAILED, EventState::SUSPENDED],
            'failed' => [EventState::PREPARING, EventState::SUSPENDED],
            'suspended' => [],
        ];

        foreach (EventState::cases() as $from) {
            foreach (EventState::cases() as $to) {
                $legal = in_array($to, $expected[$from->value], strict: true);

                $this->assertSame(
                    $legal,
                    $from->canTransitionTo($to),
                    "Edge {$from->value} -> {$to->value} must be ".($legal ? 'legal' : 'illegal').'.',
                );
            }
        }

        foreach (EventState::cases() as $state) {
            $this->assertSame(
                $state !== EventState::DRAFT,
                $state->isMetadataLocked(),
                "isMetadataLocked() changed for {$state->value}.",
            );

            $this->assertSame(
                in_array($state, [
                    EventState::DRAFT,
                    EventState::ENDED,
                    EventState::FAILED,
                    EventState::SUSPENDED,
                ], strict: true),
                $state->blocksRegistration(),
                "blocksRegistration() changed for {$state->value}.",
            );
        }
    }

    // ---------------------------------------------------------------------
    // Helpers
    // ---------------------------------------------------------------------

    private function eventFor(Team $workspace, EventState $state, bool $cancelled = false): Event
    {
        /** @var User $owner */
        $owner = $workspace->owner;

        $factory = Event::factory()->inState($state)->for($workspace);

        if ($cancelled) {
            $factory = $factory->cancelled();
        }

        return $factory->create(['created_by' => $owner->id]);
    }

    private function registerAttendee(Event $event): Registration
    {
        $email = 'registrant@example.test';

        return Registration::unguarded(fn (): Registration => Registration::query()->create([
            'team_id' => $event->team_id,
            'event_id' => $event->id,
            'email' => $email,
            'email_hash' => hash('sha256', $email),
            'source' => RegistrationSource::DIRECT->value,
            'full_name' => 'Existing Registrant',
            'consent_accepted_at' => now(),
        ]));
    }

    /**
     * A refusal is observable as a client error that leaves the stored
     * lifecycle state untouched.
     */
    private function assertRefused(TestResponse $response, Event $event, EventState $expected): void
    {
        $status = $response->status();

        $this->assertTrue(
            $status >= 400 && $status < 500,
            "Expected the revert to be refused with a client error, got HTTP {$status}.",
        );

        $this->assertSame(
            $expected,
            $event->refresh()->state,
            'A refused revert must leave the event state unchanged.',
        );
    }
}

use PHPUnit\Framework\Attributes\Group;
use PHPUnit\Framework\Attributes\Test;
use Spatie\Activitylog\Models\Activity;
use Tests\Feature\FeatureTestCase;
use Tests\Feature\SuperAdmin\Support\InteractsWithSuperAdmin;

/**
 * Capsule T6 ATDD — platform-admin revert of a PUBLISHED event back to DRAFT.
 *
 * Asserts the observable contract only: HTTP outcome, persisted state, the
 * audit row the guarded transition path writes, and the canonical
 * legal-transition table the rest of the domain reads.
 */
#[Group('events')]
class AdminRevertToDraftTest extends FeatureTestCase
{
    use InteractsWithSuperAdmin;

    // ---------------------------------------------------------------------
    // AC1 + AC2 — the action exists, is capability-gated, and goes through
    // the guarded transition path (audit record included).
    // ---------------------------------------------------------------------

    #[Test]
    public function platform_admin_reverts_published_event_to_draft_and_records_the_transition(): void
    {
        $workspace = $this->createWorkspace();
        $event = $this->eventFor($workspace, EventState::PUBLISHED);
        $platformAdmin = $this->createPlatformSuperAdmin($workspace);

        $this->actingAs($platformAdmin)
            ->postJson(route('admin.events.revert-to-draft', $event->uuid))
            ->assertOk()
            ->assertJsonPath('data.state', EventState::DRAFT->value);

        $this->assertSame(EventState::DRAFT, $event->refresh()->state);

        $activity = Activity::query()
            ->where('log_name', 'event.transitioned')
            ->where('subject_type', Event::class)
            ->where('subject_id', $event->id)
            ->latest('id')
            ->firstOrFail();

        $this->assertSame($platformAdmin->id, (int) $activity->causer_id);
        $this->assertSame(EventState::PUBLISHED->value, data_get($activity->properties, 'from'));
        $this->assertSame(EventState::DRAFT->value, data_get($activity->properties, 'to'));
    }

    #[Test]
    public function revert_route_is_capability_gated_through_route_permission_config(): void
    {
        $this->assertArrayHasKey(
            'admin.events.revert-to-draft',
            config('route_permissions.routes'),
            'The revert route must be declared in the route-permission configuration.',
        );

        $workspace = $this->createWorkspace();
        $event = $this->eventFor($workspace, EventState::PUBLISHED);
        $workspaceAdmin = $this->createWorkspaceMember($workspace, UserRole::ADMIN);

        $this->actingAs($workspaceAdmin)
            ->postJson(route('admin.events.revert-to-draft', $event->uuid))
            ->assertForbidden();

        $this->assertSame(EventState::PUBLISHED, $event->refresh()->state);
    }

    // ---------------------------------------------------------------------
    // AC3 — only a PUBLISHED event may be reverted.
    // ---------------------------------------------------------------------

    /** @return iterable<string, array{0: EventState}> */
    public static function nonPublishedStateProvider(): iterable
    {
        yield 'draft' => [EventState::DRAFT];
        yield 'preparing' => [EventState::PREPARING];
    }

    #[Test]
    #[DataProvider('nonPublishedStateProvider')]
    public function revert_is_refused_when_the_event_is_not_published(EventState $state): void
    {
        $workspace = $this->createWorkspace();
        $event = $this->eventFor($workspace, $state);
        $platformAdmin = $this->createPlatformSuperAdmin($workspace);

        $response = $this->actingAs($platformAdmin)
            ->postJson(route('admin.events.revert-to-draft', $event->uuid));

        $this->assertRefused($response, $event, $state);
    }

    // ---------------------------------------------------------------------
    // AC4 — registrations block the revert.
    // ---------------------------------------------------------------------

    #[Test]
    public function revert_is_refused_when_the_event_has_registrations(): void
    {
        $workspace = $this->createWorkspace();
        $event = $this->eventFor($workspace, EventState::PUBLISHED);
        $this->registerAttendee($event);
        $platformAdmin = $this->createPlatformSuperAdmin($workspace);

        $response = $this->actingAs($platformAdmin)
            ->postJson(route('admin.events.revert-to-draft', $event->uuid));

        $this->assertRefused($response, $event, EventState::PUBLISHED);
    }

    // ---------------------------------------------------------------------
    // AC5 — cancellation keeps winning over lifecycle moves.
    // ---------------------------------------------------------------------

    #[Test]
    public function revert_is_refused_for_a_cancelled_event(): void
    {
        $workspace = $this->createWorkspace();
        $event = $this->eventFor($workspace, EventState::PUBLISHED, cancelled: true);
        $platformAdmin = $this->createPlatformSuperAdmin($workspace);

        $response = $this->actingAs($platformAdmin)
            ->postJson(route('admin.events.revert-to-draft', $event->uuid));

        $this->assertRefused($response, $event, EventState::PUBLISHED);
        $this->assertNotNull($event->refresh()->cancelled_at);
    }

    // ---------------------------------------------------------------------
    // AC6 — the canonical table gains exactly one edge and nothing else, and
    // the state-derived rules other code reads keep their answers.
    // ---------------------------------------------------------------------

    #[Test]
    public function canonical_transition_table_gains_only_the_published_to_draft_edge(): void
    {
        $expected = [
            'draft' => [EventState::PUBLISHED, EventState::SUSPENDED, EventState::FAILED],
            // PUBLISHED -> DRAFT is the single edge this capsule introduces.
            'published' => [EventState::PREPARING, EventState::SUSPENDED, EventState::FAILED, EventState::DRAFT],
            'preparing' => [EventState::READY, EventState::FAILED, EventState::SUSPENDED],
            'ready' => [EventState::LIVE, EventState::FAILED, EventState::SUSPENDED],
            'live' => [EventState::ENDED, EventState::FAILED, EventState::SUSPENDED, EventState::READY],
            'ended' => [EventState::FAILED, EventState::SUSPENDED],
            'failed' => [EventState::PREPARING, EventState::SUSPENDED],
            'suspended' => [],
        ];

        foreach (EventState::cases() as $from) {
            foreach (EventState::cases() as $to) {
                $legal = in_array($to, $expected[$from->value], strict: true);

                $this->assertSame(
                    $legal,
                    $from->canTransitionTo($to),
                    "Edge {$from->value} -> {$to->value} must be ".($legal ? 'legal' : 'illegal').'.',
                );
            }
        }

        foreach (EventState::cases() as $state) {
            $this->assertSame(
                $state !== EventState::DRAFT,
                $state->isMetadataLocked(),
                "isMetadataLocked() changed for {$state->value}.",
            );

            $this->assertSame(
                in_array($state, [
                    EventState::DRAFT,
                    EventState::ENDED,
                    EventState::FAILED,
                    EventState::SUSPENDED,
                ], strict: true),
                $state->blocksRegistration(),
                "blocksRegistration() changed for {$state->value}.",
            );
        }
    }

    // ---------------------------------------------------------------------
    // Helpers
    // ---------------------------------------------------------------------

    private function eventFor(Team $workspace, EventState $state, bool $cancelled = false): Event
    {
        /** @var User $owner */
        $owner = $workspace->owner;

        $factory = Event::factory()->inState($state)->for($workspace);

        if ($cancelled) {
            $factory = $factory->cancelled();
        }

        return $factory->create(['created_by' => $owner->id]);
    }

    private function registerAttendee(Event $event): Registration
    {
        $email = 'registrant@example.test';

        return Registration::unguarded(fn (): Registration => Registration::query()->create([
            'team_id' => $event->team_id,
            'event_id' => $event->id,
            'email' => $email,
            'email_hash' => hash('sha256', $email),
            'source' => RegistrationSource::DIRECT->value,
            'full_name' => 'Existing Registrant',
            'consent_accepted_at' => now(),
        ]));
    }

    /**
     * A refusal is observable as a client error that leaves the stored
     * lifecycle state untouched.
     */
    private function assertRefused(TestResponse $response, Event $event, EventState $expected): void
    {
        $status = $response->status();

        $this->assertTrue(
            $status >= 400 && $status < 500,
            "Expected the revert to be refused with a client error, got HTTP {$status}.",
        );

        $this->assertSame(
            $expected,
            $event->refresh()->state,
            'A refused revert must leave the event state unchanged.',
        );
    }
}

use Illuminate\Database\Eloquent\Model;
use Illuminate\Database\Eloquent\Scope;
use Platform\Tenancy\Contracts\TenantContextInterface;

class TeamScope implements Scope
{
    /**
     * Apply the scope to a given Eloquent query builder.
     *
     * Uses TenantContextInterface from the platform-tenancy package
     * to resolve the current tenant ID. Fails closed (WHERE 1=0)
     * when no tenant context is available.
     */
    public function apply(Builder $builder, Model $model): void
    {
        $tenantContext = app(TenantContextInterface::class);

        // System admin bypass — skip scoping entirely
        if ($tenantContext->shouldBypassTenantScope()) {
            return;
        }

        $tenantId = $tenantContext->getTenantId();

        if ($tenantId !== null) {
            $builder->where(
                $model->getTable() . '.team_id',
                $tenantId
            );
        } else {
            // Fail closed — no tenant context means no records
            $builder->whereRaw('1=0');
        }
    }

    /**
     * Extend the query builder with macros.
     *
     * @param Builder $builder
     */
    public function extend(Builder $builder): void
    {
        $builder->macro("withoutTeamScope", function (Builder $builder) {
            return $builder->withoutGlobalScope(TeamScope::class);

        $builder->macro("forAllTeams", function (Builder $builder) {
            return $builder->withoutGlobalScope(TeamScope::class);

            $teamId = is_object($team) ? $team->id : $team;
            return $builder
                ->withoutGlobalScope(TeamScope::class)
                ->where("team_id", $teamId);
