<?php

declare(strict_types=1);

namespace App\Modules\Events\Enums;

/**
 * Story 2-1 — Canonical event state machine (Phase 1, 8 states, 20 legal edges).
 *
 * Single source of truth: docs/specs/event-states.md (PF-1 Reading A,
 * reconciled 2026-04-25).
 *
 * - DB column: VARCHAR — values match the lowercase string values below.
 * - SUSPENDED is reachable from any non-SUSPENDED state via EventService::suspend().
 * - Reactivation from SUSPENDED uses the audit ledger (see Story 2-6 sketch).
 */
enum EventState: string
{
    case DRAFT = 'draft';
    case PUBLISHED = 'published';
    case PREPARING = 'preparing';
    case READY = 'ready';
    case LIVE = 'live';
    case ENDED = 'ended';
    case FAILED = 'failed';
    case SUSPENDED = 'suspended';

    /**
     * Canonical legal-transition table. Mirrors docs/specs/event-states.md.
     *
     * @return list<self>
     */
    public function transitionsTo(): array
    {
        return match ($this) {
            self::DRAFT => [self::PUBLISHED, self::SUSPENDED, self::FAILED],
            self::PUBLISHED => [self::PREPARING, self::SUSPENDED, self::FAILED],
            self::PREPARING => [self::READY, self::FAILED, self::SUSPENDED],
            self::READY => [self::LIVE, self::FAILED, self::SUSPENDED],
            self::LIVE => [self::ENDED, self::FAILED, self::SUSPENDED, self::READY],
            self::ENDED => [self::FAILED, self::SUSPENDED],
            self::FAILED => [self::PREPARING, self::SUSPENDED],
            self::SUSPENDED => [],
        };
    }

    public function canTransitionTo(self $next): bool
    {
        return in_array($next, $this->transitionsTo(), strict: true);
    }

    /** SUSPENDED is reachable from any non-SUSPENDED state. */
    public function canBeSuspendedFrom(): bool
    {
        return $this !== self::SUSPENDED;
    }

    /** True when the event row's core metadata is read-only. */
    public function isMetadataLocked(): bool
    {
        return $this !== self::DRAFT;
    }

    /**
     * True when the event must reject new registrations.
     * DRAFT blocks because the landing page is private until PUBLISHED.
     */
    public function blocksRegistration(): bool
    {
        return in_array($this, [self::DRAFT, self::ENDED, self::FAILED, self::SUSPENDED], strict: true);
    }

    /**
     * Story 5-14 — True when the event is in a state that supports live
     * streaming operations (control room, go-live, end-event).
     *
     * Single source of truth for the READY|LIVE check previously duplicated
     * across EventActionAvailability, ControlRoomController::isOperable,
     * and StreamingLifecycleService claim methods.
     */
    public function isLiveOperable(): bool
    {
        return $this === self::READY || $this === self::LIVE;
    }

    /**
     * Story 5-14 — True when the event has reached the terminal ENDED state.
     */
    public function isEnded(): bool
    {
        return $this === self::ENDED;
    }

    /** Translation key for UI label. Resolves through __() at render-time. */
    public function label(): string
    {
        return __('events.state.' . $this->value);
    }

    /** @return list<string> */
    public static function values(): array
    {
        return array_map(static fn (self $s) => $s->value, self::cases());
    }

    // ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
    // Story 3-17 — Public visibility helpers
    // ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

    /**
     * Is the event completely hidden from public visitors?
     * DRAFT and FAILED events are never publicly addressable, regardless of
     * cancellation state. Cancelled-DRAFT is covered by DRAFT.
     */
    public function isPubliclyHidden(): bool
    {
        return in_array($this, [self::DRAFT, self::FAILED], strict: true);
    }

    /**
     * Which public page shell should render?
     *
     * S3-4-F3 — This is a two-level dispatch: shellFor() selects the public page
     * mode (landing/cancelled/suspended), then the Blade second-level dispatch
     * selects the viewer sub-shell via registrantViewerMode().
     *
     * @param bool $cancelled Whether cancelled_at is set on the event row
     */
    public function publicShell(bool $cancelled): string
    {
        if ($cancelled) {
            return 'cancelled';
        }

        return match ($this) {
            self::SUSPENDED => 'suspended',
            default => 'landing',
        };
    }

    /**
     * Which viewer sub-shell should render when a registrant is authenticated?
     * Returns null for states where registrant viewer access is not applicable.
     *
     * @return ?string 'registered' | 'live' | 'ended' | null
     */
    public function registrantViewerMode(): ?string
    {
        return match ($this) {
            self::PUBLISHED,
            self::PREPARING,
            self::READY => 'registered',
            self::LIVE => 'live',
            self::ENDED => 'ended',
            default => null,
        };
    }

    /**
     * Is this event eligible for public indexing (sitemap, registrant access links)?
     *
     * @param bool $cancelled Whether cancelled_at is set on the event row
     */
    public function isPubliclyIndexable(bool $cancelled): bool
    {
        if ($cancelled) {
            return false;
        }

        return in_array($this, [
            self::PUBLISHED,
            self::PREPARING,
            self::READY,
            self::LIVE,
            self::ENDED,
        ], strict: true);
    }
}

<?php

declare(strict_types=1);

namespace App\Modules\Events\Services;

use App\Models\Team;
use App\Models\User;
use App\Modules\Events\Enums\EventState;
use App\Modules\Events\Exceptions\SuspensionAuthorityMissing;
use App\Modules\Events\Models\Event;
use Illuminate\Auth\Access\AuthorizationException;
use Illuminate\Support\Facades\Gate;

/**
 * Single source of truth for events.* capability-authorization guards.
 *
 * Design mirrors BillingAuthorizationService:
 *   - No constructor injection (no collaborators needed — only Gate + actor).
 *   - Named void guards — throw on deny, return void on allow.
 *   - Preserve exact exception types per guard (the controller maps each to its
 *     own HTTP error envelope, so the type must not change):
 *       • moderation guards → SuspensionAuthorityMissing (HTTP 403)
 *       • all others        → Illuminate\Auth\Access\AuthorizationException
 *
 * Capability strings are the shared contract between this service and EventPolicy /
 * route_permissions.php — keep them identical.
 *
 * Authorization ordering rule: all guards in this class are designed to be called
 * BEFORE any DB::transaction / lockForUpdate so that capability checks never execute
 * inside a lock. Callers must preserve this call ordering.
 */
class EventAuthorizationService
{
    // -----------------------------------------------------------------------
    // Team-boundary helper
    // -----------------------------------------------------------------------

    /**
     * Assert that $actor's current team matches $targetTeamId.
     *
     * This implements the team-boundary check described in the architecture:
     * the capability registrar rejects argument-bound gate checks, so we
     * enforce the cross-team boundary explicitly before delegating to the
     * team-scoped capability.
     *
     * @throws AuthorizationException
     */
    private function assertCurrentTeamBoundary(User $actor, int $targetTeamId, string $message): void
    {
        $callerTeamId = $actor->currentTeam?->getKey();

        if ($callerTeamId === null || $callerTeamId !== $targetTeamId) {
            throw new AuthorizationException($message);
        }
    }

    // -----------------------------------------------------------------------
    // View / read guards
    // -----------------------------------------------------------------------

    /**
     * Assert actor may view the given event.
     *
     * global bypass: events.view.global
     * team cap:      events.view.team
     *
     * @throws AuthorizationException
     */
    public function authorizeView(Event $event, User $actor): void
    {
        if (Gate::forUser($actor)->allows('events.view.global')) {
            return;
        }

        $this->assertCurrentTeamBoundary(
            $actor,
            $event->team_id,
            'Cross-team event view requires events.view.global.'
        );

        Gate::forUser($actor)->authorize('events.view.team');
    }

    // -----------------------------------------------------------------------
    // viewAny guard (for list surfaces)
    // -----------------------------------------------------------------------

    /**
     * Assert actor may list events in the given team.
     *
     * Accepts Team (not Event) because list authorization is team-scoped,
     * not per-event. Preserves the current EventPolicy::viewAny behavior:
     * resolve through events.view.* capability.
     *
     * global bypass: events.view.global
     * team cap:      events.view.team
     *
     * @throws AuthorizationException
     */
    public function authorizeViewAny(Team $team, User $actor): void
    {
        if (Gate::forUser($actor)->allows('events.view.global')) {
            return;
        }

        $this->assertCurrentTeamBoundary(
            $actor,
            $team->getKey(),
            'Cross-team event listing requires events.view.global.'
        );

        Gate::forUser($actor)->authorize('events.view.team');
    }

    // -----------------------------------------------------------------------
    // Create guard
    // -----------------------------------------------------------------------

    /**
     * Assert actor may create events in the given team.
     *
     * Accepts Team (not Event) because no event exists yet at creation time.
     *
     * global bypass: events.create.global
     * team cap:      events.create.team
     *
     * @throws AuthorizationException
     */
    public function authorizeCreate(Team $team, User $actor): void
    {
        if (Gate::forUser($actor)->allows('events.create.global')) {
            return;
        }

        $this->assertCurrentTeamBoundary(
            $actor,
            $team->getKey(),
            'Cross-team event creation requires events.create.global.'
        );

        Gate::forUser($actor)->authorize('events.create.team');
    }

    // -----------------------------------------------------------------------
    // Update guard
    // -----------------------------------------------------------------------

    /**
     * Assert actor may update (metadata) events in the given team.
     *
     * Accepts Team (not Event) because callers already resolve the team from
     * the event and pass it directly (EventMetadataService, EventLandingService).
     *
     * global bypass: events.update.global
     * team cap:      events.update.team
     *
     * @throws AuthorizationException
     */
    public function authorizeUpdate(Team $team, User $actor): void
    {
        if (Gate::forUser($actor)->allows('events.update.global')) {
            return;
        }

        $this->assertCurrentTeamBoundary(
            $actor,
            $team->getKey(),
            'Cross-team event update requires events.update.global.'
        );

        Gate::forUser($actor)->authorize('events.update.team');
    }

    // -----------------------------------------------------------------------
    // Transition guards
    // -----------------------------------------------------------------------

    /**
     * Assert actor may drive a state transition on the given event.
     *
     * This general-purpose transition guard deliberately does NOT admit
     * events.force_end.global. Force-end has a dedicated transition guard below
     * so that emergency termination authority cannot become generic state
     * transition authority for public service callers.
     *
     * global bypass: events.update.global
     * team cap:      events.update.team
     *
     * @throws AuthorizationException
     */
    public function authorizeTransition(Event $event, User $actor): void
    {
        if (Gate::forUser($actor)->allows('events.update.global')) {
            return;
        }

        $this->assertCurrentTeamBoundary(
            $actor,
            $event->team_id,
            'Cross-team event transition requires events.update.global.'
        );

        Gate::forUser($actor)->authorize('events.update.team');
    }

    /**
     * Assert actor may drive the state-machine transition that backs force-end.
     *
     * This is intentionally narrower than authorizeTransition(): it only exists
     * for the force-end wrapper after authorizeForceEnd() has already passed,
     * and it only admits an ENDED target.
     *
     * @throws SuspensionAuthorityMissing
     */
    public function authorizeForceEndTransition(Event $event, EventState $next, User $actor): void
    {
        if ($next !== EventState::ENDED) {
            throw SuspensionAuthorityMissing::for($actor, $event);
        }

        $this->authorizeForceEnd($event, $actor);
    }

    // -----------------------------------------------------------------------
    // Publish guard
    // -----------------------------------------------------------------------

    /**
     * Assert actor may publish the given event (capability check only).
     *
     * The entitlement/plan-gate re-check (EVENT_PUBLISH) is NOT here — it
     * stays in EventLifecycleService::publish() immediately after this call.
     *
     * global bypass: events.publish.global
     * team cap:      events.publish.team
     *
     * @throws AuthorizationException
     */
    public function authorizePublish(Event $event, User $actor): void
    {
        if (Gate::forUser($actor)->allows('events.publish.global')) {
            return;
        }

        $this->assertCurrentTeamBoundary(
            $actor,
            $event->team_id,
            'Cross-team publish requires events.publish.global.'
        );

        Gate::forUser($actor)->authorize('events.publish.team');
    }

    public function canPublish(Event $event, User $actor): bool
    {
        $gate = Gate::forUser($actor);

        if ($gate->allows('events.publish.global')) {
            return true;
        }

        return $actor->currentTeam?->getKey() === $event->team_id
            && $gate->allows('events.publish.team');
    }

    // -----------------------------------------------------------------------
    // Cancel guard
    // -----------------------------------------------------------------------

    /**
     * Assert actor may cancel the given event.
     *
     * global bypass: events.cancel.global
     * team cap:      events.cancel.team
     *
     * @throws AuthorizationException
     */
    public function authorizeCancel(Event $event, User $actor): void
    {
        if (Gate::forUser($actor)->allows('events.cancel.global')) {
            return;
        }

        $this->assertCurrentTeamBoundary(
            $actor,
            $event->team_id,
            'Cross-team cancel requires events.cancel.global.'
        );

        Gate::forUser($actor)->authorize('events.cancel.team');
    }

    // -----------------------------------------------------------------------
    // Speaker write guard
    // -----------------------------------------------------------------------

    /**
     * Assert actor may perform speaker writes (add/update/reorder/delete) on the event.
     *
     * Authorization pattern mirrors authorizeTransition but without the
     * force_end.global bypass — speaker writes need only update authority.
     *
     * global bypass: events.update.global
     * team cap:      events.update.team
     *
     * @throws AuthorizationException
     */
    public function authorizeSpeakerWrite(Event $event, User $actor): void
    {
        if (Gate::forUser($actor)->allows('events.update.global')) {
            return;
        }

        $this->assertCurrentTeamBoundary(
            $actor,
            $event->team_id,
            'Cross-team speaker mutation requires events.update.global.'
        );

        if (Gate::forUser($actor)->allows('events.update.team')) {
            return;
        }

        Gate::forUser($actor)->authorize('events.update.team');
    }

    // -----------------------------------------------------------------------
    // Moderation guards (different shape — global-only, SuspensionAuthorityMissing)
    // -----------------------------------------------------------------------

    /**
     * Assert actor may suspend or reactivate the given event.
     *
     * Moderation guards are global-only: there is no team-scoped path.
     * The missing-cap exception is SuspensionAuthorityMissing (JKM-EVT-1004),
     * not AuthorizationException, to preserve distinct HTTP error envelopes.
     *
     * required cap: events.suspend.global
     *
     * @throws SuspensionAuthorityMissing
     */
    public function authorizeSuspend(Event $event, User $actor): void
    {
        if (! $this->canSuspend($event, $actor)) {
            throw SuspensionAuthorityMissing::for($actor, $event);
        }
    }

    public function canSuspend(Event $event, User $actor): bool
    {
        return Gate::forUser($actor)->allows('events.suspend.global');
    }

    /**
     * Assert actor may reactivate (unsuspend) the given event.
     *
     * Uses the same capability and exception as authorizeSuspend — the same
     * global role grants both suspend and reactivate authority.
     *
     * required cap: events.suspend.global
     *
     * @throws SuspensionAuthorityMissing
     */
    public function authorizeReactivate(Event $event, User $actor): void
    {
        if (! $this->canReactivate($event, $actor)) {
            throw SuspensionAuthorityMissing::for($actor, $event);
        }
    }

    public function canReactivate(Event $event, User $actor): bool
    {
        return $this->canSuspend($event, $actor);
    }

    /**
     * Assert actor may force-end the given event.
     *
     * Distinct from suspend — force_end.global is a separate two-cap.
     * Uses SuspensionAuthorityMissing for consistency with the other
     * moderation guards (same HTTP 403 / JKM-EVT-1004 envelope).
     *
     * required cap: events.force_end.global
     *
     * @throws SuspensionAuthorityMissing
     */
    public function authorizeForceEnd(Event $event, User $actor): void
    {
        if (! $this->canForceEnd($event, $actor)) {
            throw SuspensionAuthorityMissing::for($actor, $event);
        }
    }

    public function canForceEnd(Event $event, User $actor): bool
    {
        return Gate::forUser($actor)->allows('events.force_end.global');
    }
}

<?php

declare(strict_types=1);

namespace App\Modules\Events\Services;

use App\Authz\EntitlementChecker;
use App\Enums\PlatformKillSwitchKey;
use App\Exceptions\PlatformKillSwitchActiveException;
use App\Models\User;
use App\Modules\AiAudit\Enums\AiAuditOrganizerStatus;
use App\Modules\AiAudit\Services\AiAuditRequestService;
use App\Modules\Events\Contracts\Repositories\EventRepositoryInterface;
use App\Modules\Events\Enums\EventOperationalLockKey;
use App\Modules\Events\Enums\EventState;
use App\Modules\Events\Events\EventCancelled;
use App\Modules\Events\Exceptions\EventOperationalLockActive;
use App\Modules\Events\Exceptions\EventStateLocked;
use App\Modules\Events\Exceptions\IllegalStateTransition;
use App\Modules\Events\Exceptions\PlanGateFailed;
use App\Modules\Events\Exceptions\PublishPrerequisiteMissing;
use App\Modules\Events\Models\Event;
use App\Modules\Events\Support\EventAuditEvents;
use App\Scopes\TeamScope;
use App\Services\PlatformKillSwitchService;
use Illuminate\Support\Facades\DB;
use Illuminate\Support\Facades\Event as EventDispatcher;
use Platform\AuditLogging\Contracts\AuditLoggerInterface;

/**
 * Epic 2 refactor — lifecycle cluster extracted from EventService (publish + cancel).
 *
 * Move-only: all bodies are byte-for-byte from EventService.
 * Mechanical rewrites:
 *   - $this->transition(...) → $this->stateMachine->transition(...) in publish() (1 site)
 *   - $this->authorizeEventPublish(...) → $this->authorizeEventPublish(...) (stays private here)
 *   - $this->authorizeEventCancel(...) → $this->authorizeEventCancel(...) (stays private here)
 *   - $this->entitlements → $this->entitlements (promoted to constructor param)
 * Error-log tag updated: '[EventService]' → '[EventLifecycleService]'.
 */
class EventLifecycleService
{
    public const PUBLISH_REASON_PLAN_GATE = 'plan_gate';

    public function __construct(
        private readonly AuditLoggerInterface $auditLogger,
        private readonly EntitlementChecker $entitlements,
        private readonly EventRepositoryInterface $events,
        private readonly EventStateMachineService $stateMachine,
        private readonly EventAuthorizationService $authz,
        private readonly AiAuditRequestService $aiAuditRequests,
        private readonly PlatformKillSwitchService $killSwitches,
        private readonly EventOperationalLockService $operationalLocks,
    ) {}

    public function publish(Event $event, User $actor): Event
    {
        // R1 BLOCKER #1 (2-3b) — service-layer Gate.
        // events.publish.team is Admin-only (per AC5: Co-host CANNOT publish).
        // This MUST run before the entitlement check so a Co-host on a Pro
        // plan does not fall through into transition() via events.update.team.
        // Entitlement/plan-gate check is NOT here — it stays in publish() after this call.
        $this->authz->authorizePublish($event, $actor);

        $this->assertMutablePublishPrerequisites($event, $actor);

        if ($event->state === EventState::PUBLISHED) {
            return $this->stateMachine->transition($event, EventState::PUBLISHED, $actor, 'admin.publish');
        }

        // Phase 1: the explicit organizer command may create/reuse and
        // synchronously triage the current snapshot. Provider I/O happens
        // before any event transaction or event-row lock.
        $decision = $this->aiAuditRequests->ensureCurrentPublishDecisionOrRequest($event);

        if (! $decision->isApproved()) {
            throw PublishPrerequisiteMissing::aiAudit($event, $decision->status);
        }

        // Provider latency creates a new authorization boundary. Reload the
        // actor/team context and invalidate its supported permission cache
        // before re-running the publish capability guard. Authorization must
        // remain outside every transaction and row lock.
        $freshActor = User::query()
            ->with('currentTeam')
            ->findOrFail($actor->getKey());
        $freshActor->clearAllPermissionCache();
        $this->authz->authorizePublish($event, $freshActor);

        // Phase 2: serialize content writers on the event row, reload every
        // mutable gate, and recompute the E-AIA-owned current-snapshot result.
        // EventStateMachineService remains the sole state writer and owns the
        // atomic transition audit plus after-commit domain event.
        return DB::transaction(function () use ($event, $freshActor): Event {
            $fresh = $this->events->lockEventForServiceWrite($event->getKey());

            if ($fresh->state === EventState::PUBLISHED) {
                return $fresh;
            }

            $this->assertMutablePublishPrerequisites($fresh, $freshActor, freshEntitlement: true);

            $finalDecision = $this->aiAuditRequests->lockCurrentPublishDecisionForEvent($fresh);

            if (! $finalDecision->isApproved()) {
                throw PublishPrerequisiteMissing::aiAudit($fresh, $finalDecision->status);
            }

            return $this->stateMachine->transition($fresh, EventState::PUBLISHED, $freshActor, 'admin.publish');
        }, attempts: 1);
    }

    private function assertMutablePublishPrerequisites(
        Event $event,
        User $actor,
        bool $freshEntitlement = false,
    ): void {
        if ($this->killSwitches->active(PlatformKillSwitchKey::PUBLISH)) {
            throw new PlatformKillSwitchActiveException(PlatformKillSwitchKey::PUBLISH);
        }

        if ($this->operationalLocks->active($event, EventOperationalLockKey::PUBLISH)) {
            throw new EventOperationalLockActive($event, EventOperationalLockKey::PUBLISH);
        }

        $hasPublishEntitlement = $freshEntitlement
            ? $this->entitlements->hasFreshEntitlementForTeam($actor, $event->team_id, 'PUBLISH')
            : $this->entitlements->hasEntitlementForTeam($actor, $event->team_id, 'PUBLISH');

        if (! $hasPublishEntitlement) {
            throw PlanGateFailed::for($event, 'PUBLISH');
        }

        if ($event->cancelled_at !== null) {
            throw EventStateLocked::for($event);
        }

        if (! in_array($event->state, [EventState::DRAFT, EventState::PUBLISHED], strict: true)) {
            throw IllegalStateTransition::between($event->state, EventState::PUBLISHED);
        }

        if ($event->state === EventState::DRAFT && ! $this->hasPublishableLanding($event)) {
            throw PublishPrerequisiteMissing::landingPage($event);
        }
    }

    /**
     * @return array{allowed: bool, reason: string|null, attemptable: bool, reason_code?: string, audit?: array{status: string, message: string}}
     */
    public function publishReadiness(Event $event, ?User $actor): array
    {
        if (! $actor instanceof User) {
            return [
                'allowed' => false,
                'reason' => __('events.publish.unavailable.unauthorized'),
                'attemptable' => false,
            ];
        }

        if (! $this->authz->canPublish($event, $actor)) {
            return [
                'allowed' => false,
                'reason' => __('events.publish.unavailable.unauthorized'),
                'attemptable' => false,
            ];
        }

        if ($this->killSwitches->active(PlatformKillSwitchKey::PUBLISH)) {
            return [
                'allowed' => false,
                'reason' => __('events.publish.unavailable.platform_disabled'),
                'attemptable' => true,
            ];
        }

        if ($this->operationalLocks->active($event, EventOperationalLockKey::PUBLISH)) {
            return [
                'allowed' => false,
                'reason' => __('events.publish.unavailable.operations_locked'),
                'attemptable' => false,
            ];
        }

        if (! $this->entitlements->hasEntitlementForTeam($actor, $event->team_id, 'PUBLISH')) {
            return [
                'allowed' => false,
                'reason' => __('events.publish.unavailable.plan_gate'),
                'reason_code' => self::PUBLISH_REASON_PLAN_GATE,
                'attemptable' => false,
            ];
        }

        if ($event->cancelled_at !== null) {
            return [
                'allowed' => false,
                'reason' => __('events.publish.unavailable.state_locked'),
                'attemptable' => false,
            ];
        }

        private readonly AuditLoggerInterface $auditLogger,
        private readonly EntitlementChecker $entitlements,
        private readonly EventRepositoryInterface $events,

        private readonly EventAuthorizationService $authz,

    public function publish(Event $event, User $actor): Event

        // events.publish.team is Admin-only (per AC5: Co-host CANNOT publish).
        // This MUST run before the entitlement check so a Co-host on a Pro
        // plan does not fall through into transition() via events.update.team.
        // Entitlement/plan-gate check is NOT here — it stays in publish() after this call.
        $this->authz->authorizePublish($event, $actor);

        $this->assertMutablePublishPrerequisites($event, $actor);

        if ($event->state === EventState::PUBLISHED) {
            return $this->stateMachine->transition($event, EventState::PUBLISHED, $actor, 'admin.publish');
        }

        // Phase 1: the explicit organizer command may create/reuse and
        // synchronously triage the current snapshot. Provider I/O happens
        // before any event transaction or event-row lock.
        $decision = $this->aiAuditRequests->ensureCurrentPublishDecisionOrRequest($event);

        if (! $decision->isApproved()) {
            throw PublishPrerequisiteMissing::aiAudit($event, $decision->status);
        }

        // actor/team context and invalidate its supported permission cache
        // before re-running the publish capability guard. Authorization must
        // remain outside every transaction and row lock.
        $freshActor = User::query()
            ->with('currentTeam')
            ->findOrFail($actor->getKey());
        $freshActor->clearAllPermissionCache();
        $this->authz->authorizePublish($event, $freshActor);

        // Phase 2: serialize content writers on the event row, reload every
        // mutable gate, and recompute the E-AIA-owned current-snapshot result.
        // EventStateMachineService remains the sole state writer and owns the
        // atomic transition audit plus after-commit domain event.
        return DB::transaction(function () use ($event, $freshActor): Event {
            $fresh = $this->events->lockEventForServiceWrite($event->getKey());

            if ($fresh->state === EventState::PUBLISHED) {
                return $fresh;
            }

            $this->assertMutablePublishPrerequisites($fresh, $freshActor, freshEntitlement: true);

        User $actor,

            throw EventStateLocked::for($event);

                'allowed' => false,

                'attemptable' => true,

                'allowed' => false,
                'reason' => __('events.publish.unavailable.operations_locked'),
                'attemptable' => false,

        }

            return [
                'allowed' => false,
                'reason' => __('events.publish.unavailable.plan_gate'),
                'reason_code' => self::PUBLISH_REASON_PLAN_GATE,
                'attemptable' => false,
            ];
        }

            return [
                'allowed' => false,
                'reason' => __('events.publish.unavailable.state_locked'),
                'attemptable' => false,
            ];
        }

        if (! in_array($event->state, [EventState::DRAFT, EventState::PUBLISHED], strict: true)) {
            return [
                'allowed' => false,
                'reason' => __('events.publish.unavailable.not_draft'),
                'attemptable' => false,

        }

                'reason' => __('events.publish.unavailable.landing_required'),
                'attemptable' => false,
            ];
        }

            return [
                'allowed' => true,
                'reason' => null,
                'attemptable' => false,
            ];
        }

            'status' => $auditDecision->status->value,
            'message' => $this->auditStatusMessage($auditDecision->status),

        if (! $auditDecision->isApproved()) {
            return [
                'allowed' => false,
                'reason' => $audit['message'],
                'attemptable' => $auditDecision->status === AiAuditOrganizerStatus::PRE_REVIEW,
                'audit' => $audit,
            ];

            'allowed' => true,
            'reason' => null,
            'attemptable' => true,
            'audit' => $audit,

     * Mirrors publish()'s phase-2 shape: authorize outside every transaction,
     * then take the event row lock and re-read the gates before handing the

     */

    {

            $fresh = $this->events->lockEventForServiceWrite($event->getKey());

            ->withoutGlobalScope(TeamScope::class)

            ->where('template', '!=', '')

                // Bubble the decision out — denied audit is emitted post-tx in
                // its own transaction so a logger throw cannot mask the typed
                // EventStateLocked exception (2-3a R2 lesson).

/**

class EventController extends Controller
{
    public function __construct(
        private readonly EventService $eventService,
        private readonly EventActionAvailability $eventActionAvailability,
        private readonly EventSourceBreakdownReportService $sourceBreakdownReport,
        private readonly EventReportDashboardService $reportDashboard,
        private readonly AudienceBoostCampaignReportService $audienceBoostCampaignReport,
        private readonly EventOperationalLockService $operationalLocks,
        private readonly StreamingAssetOperationsService $streamingAssetOperations,
        private readonly ReplayRecordingDownloadService $recordingDownloads,
    ) {}

    public function create(): View
    {
        if (! authUser()?->currentTeam) {
            abort(403, __('events.errors.no_active_workspace'));
        }

        return view('events::events.create', [
            'breadcrumbs' => [
                ['label' => __('events.list.title'), 'route' => 'events.index'],
                ['label' => __('events.create.title'), 'route' => null],
            ],
            // Defaults: tomorrow at the current top-of-hour for start, +1 hour for end.
            'defaultStartsAt' => ($startsAt = now()->addDay()->startOfHour())->format('Y-m-d\TH:i'),
            'defaultEndsAt' => $startsAt->copy()->addHour()->format('Y-m-d\TH:i'),
            'defaultTimezone' => old('timezone', config('app.timezone', 'UTC')),
            'timezones' => $this->timezoneOptions(),

    public function store(StoreEventRequest $request): JsonResponse|RedirectResponse
    {
        /** @var User $user */
        $user = authUser();

        $team = $user->currentTeam;
        if (! $team) {
            abort(403, __('events.errors.no_active_workspace'));
        }

        try {
            $event = $this->eventService->createDraft(
                team: $team,
                actor: $user,
                metadata: $request->eventMetadata(),
            );
        } catch (EventCreditExhaustedException $exception) {
            if (! $request->expectsJson()) {
                return redirect()
                    ->route('events.create')
                    ->withErrors(['create' => $exception->getMessage()])
                    ->withInput()
                    ->with('reference', $exception->errorCode());
            }

            return response()->json([
                'error' => [
                    'code' => $exception->errorCode(),
                    'message' => $exception->getMessage(),
                ],
            ], $exception->httpStatus());
        }

        if (! $request->expectsJson()) {
            return redirect()
                ->route('events.show', $event)
                ->with('status', __('events.create.success'));
        }

        return response()->json([
            'data' => [
                'uuid' => $event->uuid,
                'state' => $event->state->value,
                'title' => $event->title,
                'starts_at' => $event->starts_at?->toIso8601String(),
                'ends_at' => $event->ends_at?->toIso8601String(),
                'timezone' => $event->timezone,

    /**

    public function edit(Request $request, Event $event): View|RedirectResponse

    public function update(UpdateEventRequest $request, Event $event): JsonResponse|RedirectResponse

        if (! $request->expectsJson()) {

        if ($request->expectsJson()) {

                    'state' => $event->state->value,
                    'title' => $event->title,

            ],
            'event' => $event,
            'adminContext' => $adminContext,
            'editAction' => $eventActions['edit'] ?? ['visible' => false, 'enabled' => false],
            'publishAction' => $eventActions['publish'] ?? ['visible' => false, 'enabled' => false],
            'prepareAction' => $eventActions['prepare'] ?? ['visible' => false, 'enabled' => false],
            'cancelAction' => $eventActions['cancel'] ?? ['visible' => false, 'enabled' => false],
            'landingAction' => $eventActions['manageLanding'] ?? ['visible' => false, 'enabled' => false],
            'registrationFormAction' => $eventActions['manageRegistrationForm'] ?? ['visible' => false, 'enabled' => false],

            'audienceBoostAction' => $eventActions['manageAudienceBoost'] ?? ['visible' => false, 'enabled' => false],
            'controlRoomAction' => $eventActions['controlRoom'] ?? ['visible' => false, 'enabled' => false],
            'publishReady' => $publishReadiness ?? ['allowed' => false, 'reason' => __('events.publish.unavailable.unavailable')],
            'moderationActions' => $this->eventService->moderationActions($event, authUser()),
            'operationalLocks' => $adminContext ? $this->operationalLocks->states($event) : [],
            'operationalLockActions' => $adminContext ? [

            'streamingAssetActions' => $adminContext ? [

            ] : [],
            'eventReport' => $this->reportDashboard->dashboardFor($event),
            'recordingDownloadAvailable' => $this->recordingDownloads->availableFor($event, authUser()),
            'sourceBreakdown' => $this->sourceBreakdownReport->breakdownFor($event),
            'audienceBoostCampaignReport' => $this->audienceBoostCampaignReport->reportFor($event),
        ]);
    }

    /** Keep bookmarked Prepare URLs working while the workflow lives in Control Room. */
    public function prepareRedirect(Event $event): RedirectResponse
    {
        $this->eventService->authorizeViewAccess($event, authUser());

        return redirect()->route('events.control-room', ['eventUuid' => $event->uuid]);
    }

    /**
     * @param  array<string, mixed>  $payload
     */
    private function publishErrorResponse(Request $request, array $payload, int $status, string $message): JsonResponse|RedirectResponse
    {
        if (! $request->expectsJson()) {
            $auditStatus = data_get($payload, 'error.audit.status');

            if (is_string($auditStatus)) {
                return redirect()
                    ->back()
                    ->with('publish_audit_status', $auditStatus);
            }

            return redirect()
                ->back()
                ->withErrors(['publish' => $message]);
        }

        return response()->json($payload, $status);
    }

    private function isAdminEventRoute(Request $request): bool
    {
        return $request->routeIs('admin.events.*');
    }

    private function eventRouteName(Request $request, string $suffix): string
    {
        return ($this->isAdminEventRoute($request) ? 'admin.events.' : 'events.').$suffix;
    }

    /**
     * @param  array<string, mixed>  $payload
     */
    private function cancelErrorResponse(Request $request, array $payload, int $status, string $message): JsonResponse|RedirectResponse
    {
        if (! $request->expectsJson()) {
            return redirect()
                ->back()
                ->withErrors(['cancel' => $message]);
        }

        return response()->json($payload, $status);
    }

    private function domainErrorResponse(Request $request, EventDomainException $e, string $errorBag): JsonResponse|RedirectResponse
    {
        if (! $request->expectsJson()) {
            return redirect()
                ->back()
                ->withErrors([$errorBag => __('events.errors.domain_error')])
                ->with('reference', $e->errorCode());
        }

        return response()->json([
            'error' => [
                'code' => $e->errorCode(),
                'message' => __('events.errors.domain_error'),
            ],
        ], $e->httpStatus());
    }

    /**
     * @return array<int, array{id: string, name: string, offset: int}>
     */
    private function timezoneOptions(): array
    {
        $now = new DateTimeImmutable('now');
        $options = array_map(static function (string $timezone) use ($now): array {
            $offset = (new DateTimeZone($timezone))->getOffset($now);

            return [
                'id' => $timezone,
                'name' => sprintf('%s %s', self::formatOffset($offset), $timezone),
                'offset' => $offset,
            ];
        }, DateTimeZone::listIdentifiers(DateTimeZone::ALL));

        usort($options, static function (array $left, array $right): int {
            if ($left['id'] === 'UTC') {
                return -1;
            }

            if ($right['id'] === 'UTC') {
                return 1;
            }

            return [abs($left['offset']), -$left['offset'], $left['id']]
                <=> [abs($right['offset']), -$right['offset'], $right['id']];
        });

        return $options;
    }

    private static function formatOffset(int $offset): string
    {
        $sign = $offset >= 0 ? '+' : '-';
        $absolute = abs($offset);
        $hours = intdiv($absolute, 3600);
        $minutes = intdiv($absolute % 3600, 60);

        return sprintf('UTC%s%02d:%02d', $sign, $hours, $minutes);
    }
}

# Events Module — agent rules

## Canonical specs to read BEFORE editing

- `docs/specs/event-states.md` — 8-state machine, 19 legal edges (PF-1 Reading A reconciled 2026-04-25).
- `_bmad-output/planning-artifacts/event-service-sketch-2026-04-25.md` — full EventService contract for the epic.
- `_bmad-output/planning-artifacts/test-design-epic-2.md` — risk model, P0 coverage, fixture strategy.

## BMAD workflow fidelity

If a BMAD skill is named or required by the active flow, follow the real skill workflow. Do not substitute a hand-written "equivalent" artifact and do not mark the phase complete until the required skill outputs exist on disk.

## Hard rules

1. **Never write business logic or direct queries in Livewire/controllers.** No `Model::query()`, `::where()`, `::find()`, `->paginate()`, or `DB::table()` calls inside any Livewire component or controller — even for reads. All data access goes through `EventService`. Controllers stay thin (validation + delegation + serialisation).
2. **Never bypass the state machine.** State writes ONLY via `EventService::transition()` or its wrappers (`publish`, `cancel`, `suspend`, `reactivate`). Direct `$event->state = ...; $event->save()` is forbidden.
3. **Single transaction for state + audit.** Every state-changing method writes the new state AND emits the audit row in the same `DB::transaction()` block. Audit failure rolls back state.
4. **Lock before re-checking state.** Inside `transition()`, the row is `lockForUpdate()`ed and state + `cancelled_at` are re-read inside the lock before the next state is computed.
5. **Domain events fire AFTER commit.** Use `DB::afterCommit()` or the post-tx dispatch pattern. Never dispatch a Laravel event inside the tx.
6. **Capability via Authz package.** Routes use `route.permission` middleware + `config/route_permissions.php`. Never write a custom `Ensure*` middleware. Capabilities are 3-segment dotted (e.g., `events.create.team`).
7. **Module views.** All views live under `app/Modules/Events/Resources/views/`. Render with `view('events::...')`. No views under `resources/views/events/`.
8. **i18n.** All user-facing strings via `__('events.*')`. Keys live in `lang/en/events.php` and `lang/tr/events.php` and must be parity-tested.
9. **TeamScope bypass discipline.** Do not call `->withoutGlobalScope(\App\Scopes\TeamScope::class)` inside `EventService` / `SpeakerService` / `EventRepository` for SYSTEM_ADMIN cross-team work — that is already handled at the scope layer by `User::shouldBypassTeamScope()`. Bypass is legitimate only for:
   - public visitor surfaces with no tenant context (`findPublicLandingEvent`, `findPublicRegistrant`, `findPublicRegistrationSupportEvent`, `resendPublicRegistrationConfirmation`), and

### Verification
```

```
RED before implementation was genuine missing behaviour: `RouteNotFoundException: Route [admin.events.revert-to-draft] not defined` (5 errors), missing route-permission key, and `Edge published -> draft must be legal` — no syntax, import, or harness failures. The RED test was committed unchanged and never weakened.

Adjacent suites re-run green after the change: `tests/Unit/Events/EventStateTest.php` (51), `tests/Feature/Events/EventTransitionTest.php` (30), `tests/Feature/Authz/RouteMappingArchitectureTest.php` (4), `tests/Feature/Lang/EventsTranslationParityTest.php` (2), `tests/Feature/SuperAdmin/EventsIndexTest.php` (16), `tests/Feature/SuperAdmin/SuperAdminNavigationTest.php` (2).

### Changed paths
Commit `3d4a7c08` — `test: RED for T6`
- `tests/Feature/Events/AdminRevertToDraftTest.php`

Commit `82687230` — `feat: implement T6`
- `app/Modules/Events/Enums/EventState.php` — one new edge, `PUBLISHED → DRAFT`
- `app/Modules/Events/Exceptions/EventHasRegistrations.php` — new (`JKM-EVT-1013`, 409)
- `app/Modules/Events/Services/EventAuthorizationService.php` — `authorizeRevertToDraft` (global-only, `events.publish.global`)
- `app/Modules/Events/Services/EventLifecycleService.php` — `revertToDraft` wrapper: authorize outside the tx, then row lock → re-check `state === PUBLISHED` → re-check registrations → delegate the write to `EventStateMachineService::transition`, which keeps the cancellation re-check and the `event.transitioned` audit row
- `app/Modules/Events/Services/EventService.php`, `Http/Controllers/EventController.php` — delegation + `EventDomainException` → `domainErrorResponse`
- `app/Modules/SuperAdmin/Routes/web.php`, `config/route_permissions.php` — named POST route + capability entry
- `lang/en/events.php`, `lang/tr/events.php` — success flash key (both locales, parity-tested)
- `app/Modules/Events/CLAUDE.md` — error-code table row

### Notes and unresolved risk
- The state-machine guard rejects any non-PUBLISHED source explicitly rather than letting `transition()` absorb `DRAFT → DRAFT` as a same-state no-op, which would have returned 200 on a refusal case (AC3).
- `hasRegistrations()` bypasses `TeamScope`. The module's CLAUDE.md rule 9 discourages that for SYSTEM_ADMIN cross-team *reads*; here the scope fails closed, so a tenant-less context would answer "no registrations" and open the guard. Authorization runs before the bypass, and `hasPublishableLanding()` in the same class sets the same precedent for prerequisite checks — but it is a deliberate deviation worth a reviewer's eye.
- The new edge is added to the shared canonical table, so `transition()` would accept `PUBLISHED → DRAFT` from any future caller. Today no other caller can reach it (every path is a fixed-target wrapper), and the narrowing lives in `revertToDraft`. If a generic transition endpoint is ever added, that narrowing needs to move into the machine.
- Only the suites listed above were re-run; I did not run the full suite.
